text.body:
dhātukārikā prārambhaḥ natvā naṭeśaṃ nikhilavarṇāmnāyādideśikam| śrī kaṇṭhastanute dhātukārikāṃ bālarañjanīm||1|| kośamāmarasiṃhaṃ ca bodhārthaṃ nāmaliṅgayoḥ| dharmādhikāri śrī cakravartyayyaṅgāryanirmitām||2|| subantaśabdabhedānāṃ bodhinīṃ śabdakārikām| abhyasya tadvaddhātūnāmapi bodhārthamicchatām||3|| duradhyayatvātprācīnadhātupāṭhasya sīdatām| kautukādyācamānānāṃ bālānāṃ parituṣṭaye||4|| prāgadhātupāṭha evādya kāvyamārge cariṣṇubhiḥ| supaṭhābhissubodhābhiḥ kārikābhiryathākramam||5|| saṅgṛhayate'tra sudhiyo garhantāṃ māṃ stuvantu vā| bhvādyādayo daśagaṇāstathā kaṇḍvādidhātavaḥ||6|| ātmanepadinaścātra parasmaipadinastathā| dvayavantastathā seṭo'niṭaścāminmito'khilāḥ||7|| anubandhanibandhāśca tattatkāryaprayojanāḥ| nirūpyante'rthanirdeśo bhaimaseno'pi durgamaḥ||8|| prācāṃ vyākhyākrameṇaiva viśadīkriyate manāk| padye yadyapi vākyānāṃ padyāntaragataiḥ padaiḥ||9|| anvayo neti niyamo na kvāpi paridṛśyate|10|| tathā'pi kavibhiḥ kāvye bubhustukleśaśāntaye| niyame'sminnāśrite'pi tatra tatra kvacitkvacit||11|| dṛṣṭatvāt vyatirekasyāpyanuvādavaśādiha| tatra tatra ślokagānāṃ vākyānāmanvaye kvacit||12|| sahyaṃ paurvāparyakṛtaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ hṛdayālubhiḥ| tatrānvayāsaṃśayārthaṃ tvantāthādi na pūrvabhāk||13|| ityeṣo'marasiṃhasya niyamo'ṅgīkṛto mayā| sattāyāṃ bhūssacodātto'thānudāttānubandhakāḥ||14|| edhādayaśca kathyantāḥ ṣaṭ‌triṃśaddhātavaḥ kramāt| vṛddhāvedhassmṛtasspardhassaṅgharṣe'yaṃ tvakarmakaḥ||15||
parābhibhavanecchātra saṅgharṣa iti kathyate| parasya karmaṇo dhātorarthenaivopasaṅgahāt||16|| gādhṛ granthe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ lipsāyāmapi kathyate| viloḍane bādhṛ tacca pratighāto'bhidhīyate||17|| yācñāśīrupatāpeṣvāpyaiśvarye nāthṛnādhṛ ca| āśiṣyevānudāttetko nāthatiḥ praṇigadyate||18|| dadhassmṛto dhāraṇe'tha skudirāpravaṇe mataḥ| ihāpravaṇaśabdenotplavanoddharaṇe smṛte||19|| śvidiśśavaitye'karmako'yaṃ vadisstutyabhivādayoḥ| bhadissukhe ca kalyāṇe madirmode made stutau||20|| svapnekāntau gatau cātha kiñciccalanakarmaṇi| spadi klidistu samproktaśśokātmaparidevane||21||
ataḥ sakarmakaḥ prokto mudo harṣe'bhidhīyate| dado dāneṣvadasvardāvathāsvādanakarmaṇi||22|| sakarmako'nubhūtau syādrucau svadirakarmakaḥ| mānakrīḍanayorurdaḥ kurdaḥ khurdaśca gurdatiḥ||23|| gudaśca catvāra ete krīḍāyāmeva hi smṛtāḥ| ṣūdassyātkṣaraṇe hādo'vyak‌te śabde nigadyate||24|| halādīssukhe'vyaktaśabde svāda āsvādane smṛtaḥ||25|| pardassyātkustite śabde śabdo gudaravastvasau| yatīḥ prayatne yutṛ ca bhāsane jutṛ ca smṛtaḥ||26|| yācane vidhṛ vedhṛsyācchrathi śaithilya īritaḥ| kauṭilye tu grathiḥ katthaśślāghāyāmabhidhīyate||27|| aṣṭātriṃśattavargīyavarṇāntā atha dhātavaḥ| parasmaipadabhājo'tra nigadyante yathākramam||28|| atastā tatya gamane citī saṃjñāna uccate| āsecane cyutirproktastaccārdrīkaraṇaṃ smṛtam||29|| aṅīṣadarthe'bhivyāptāvapi jñeyaścyutirtataḥ| kṣaraṇe'yaṃ yakāreṇa rahito'pi satāṃ mataḥ||30|| mantho viloḍane'tha syuḥ kuthiḥ puthi luthī mathiḥ| saṅkleśane'tha hiṃsāyāmatha gatyāṃ ṣidhassmṛtaḥ||31|| śāstre māṅgalye ca ṣidhūḥ śāstraṃ śāsanamucyate| khādṛ prokto bakṣaṇe'tha khadassyātsthairyahiṃsayoḥ||32|| bhakṣaṇaṃ cā'karmako'yaṃ sthairye'tha bada īritaḥ| sthairye gadastu vyaktoktau syādradastu vilekhane||33|| vilekhanaṃ bedanaṃ syācchabde'vyak‌te ṇadassamṛtaḥ| gatiyācanayo rardaśśabdena gardatī||34|| hiṃsāyāṃ tardati kardaḥ kutsite śabda iṣyate| vivakṣitaḥ kutsito'tra śabdaḥ kaukṣo hi tadvidām||35|| proktaḥ khardo dandaśūke daṃśahiṃsādirūpiṇi| dandaśūkakriyeṣṭātra dandaśūkapadena tu||36|| bandhane'ti radiścediḥ paramaiśvarya iṣyate||37|| bidistvavayave vaktraikadeśe gaḍirucyate| atyādayo'tra pañcaite tiṅo na viṣayā iti||38|. manyate kāśyapo'nye tu vāñchantyeṣāṃ tiṅo'pi ca| kutsāyāṃ ṇidirākhyātassamṛddhau ṭu nadissmṛtaḥ||39|| āhlādane cadiḥ proktaśceṣṭāyāṃ tradirucyate| kadiḥ kradiḥ kladiścoktā āhvāne rodane'pi ca||40|| paridevana ākhyātaḥ klidiśśundhastu śocane| athocyante dhātavo dvicatvāriṃśadyathākramam||41|| kavargīyākṣarāntāstetvanudāttānubandhakāḥ| śīkṛ syātsecane'yaṃ tu tālavyādiramuṃ pare||42|| dantyādimāhurlokṛsyāddarśane ślokṛ kathyate| saṅghāte syātsa tu grantho grathyamānakriyā'thavā||43|| grathiturvā kriyeṣṭādye'karmakassyādvitīyake| sakarmako'thadrekṛ syāt‌dhekṛ cotsāhakarmaṇi||44|| śabde cotsāha ākhyāto vṛddhiraunnatyameva ca| śaṅkāyāṃ rekṛ samproktassekṛsrekṛsrakiśśrakiḥ||45|| ślakiśca syurgatāvatra trayo dantyādayassmṛtāḥ| tālavyādyāvubhau syātāṃ śaṅkāyāṃ kathyate śakiḥ||46|| akistu lakṣaṇe'tha syādvakiḥ kauṭilyakarmaṇi| makistu maṇḍane laulye kako laulyaṃ tu cāpalam||47|| garvaścātha kuka prokto vṛkaścādānakarmaṇi| cakastṛptau pratīghāte cāthagatyāṃ tu kaṅgatiḥ||48|| vakiśśvakistra kirḍhaukṛtraukṛṣvaṣkaścavaskatiḥ| maskaṣṭikṛtathā ṭīkṛtikṛ tikṛraghirlaghiḥ||49|| tṛtīyastviha dantyādiriti kecitpracakṣate| laghirbhuktinivṛttāvāpyaghirvaghimaghītrayaḥ||50|| gatyākṣepe smṛtā nindākṣopo'tra parikīrtitaḥ| anye prāhurgatau gatyārambhe ceti maghistu saḥ||51|| kaitave vātha sāmarthye drāghṛrāgha ca lāghṛ ca| kecitpeṭhurdhrāghṛdhātumapi cātraiva daṇḍake||52|| āyāme ca drāghati ssyādāyāmo dairghyamucyate| ślāghṛsyātka tthane'thātra parasmaipadidhātavaḥ||53|| pañcāśadabhidhīyante kavargīyākṣarāntimāḥ| nīcairgatau phakkatisyādhvahāro'satāmiha||54|| syātāṃ mandagatiścāpi nīcairgatipadoditau| takassyād‌dhasane kṛcchrajīvane takiruccate||55|| bukkassyād‌bhaṣaṇe svānaśśuno bhaṣaṇamucyate| kakhatirdhāturiha tu prokto hasanakarmaṇi||56|| okhṛdhātūrākhṛ lākhṛ drākhṛ dhrākhṛ ca śoṣaṇe| alamarthe cātha śākhṛślākhṛca vyāptikarmaṇi||57|| ukhokhī vakhatiścātha vakhirmakhamakhī ṇakhaḥ| ṇakhīrakharakhī cātha tathā lakhalakhī ikhaḥ||58|| ikhirīkhirvalga ragī lagiścāgirvagirmagiḥ| tagistvagiśśragiścātha ślagiścegī rigirligiḥ||59|| gatāvaṣṭāviṃśatiḥ syuḥ khāntāḥ pañcadaśātra ca| gāntāstrayodaśāstrānye paṭhanti caturo'dhikam||60|| rikhaṃtrakhaṃ trakhiśikhī api khānteṣu sūrayaḥ|
tvagi syātkampane cātha yugirjugibagī api||61|| varjane'tha ghaghaḥ prokto hasane maṇḍane maghiḥ| āghrāṇe śaṅgaghatiratha cavargīyā'kṣarāntimāḥ||62|| ekaviṃśatirucyante hyanudāttānubandhakāḥ| varco dīptāvatha proktaṣṣacassecanasevayoḥ||63|| locṛ syāddarśane vāci vyaktāyāṃ śacati smṛtaḥ| śvacaśvacī gatau proktau kaco bandhanakarmaṇi||64|| dīptibandhanayoḥ prokto kaci kācī ubhāvapi| maco muci kalkane syāddambhaśśāṭhyaṃ ca kalkanam||65|| anye katthanamityāhurmacirdhāraṇapūjayoḥ| ucchrāye cāpyatha vyak‌tīkaraṇe vaciriṣyate||66|| ṣṭucaḥ prasāde-ṛjatirgatau sthāne'rjanepi ca| upārjane'pyatha ṛjibhṛjī bharjanakarmaṇi||67|| ejṛ bhrejabhrājṛ dīptāvījatirgatikutsayoḥ| parasmaipadinaḥ proktā vrajyantāśca dvisaptatiḥ||68|| śucaśśokekucaśśabde tāre kruñcati kuñcatī| kauṭilyālpībhāvayossyālluñco'panayane'ñcutu||69|| gatipūjanayorvañcuścañcustañcurapi kramāt| tvañcumruñcumlunñurapi gatyarthe'ṣṭau mrucurmlucuḥ||70|| gracurglucuḥ kujukhujūssamproktāssteyakarmaṇi| gatau gluñcuśca ṣasjaśca sajjatiścātmanepadi||71|| gujistvavyaktaśabde syātpujāyāmarcatissmṛtaḥ| lmeccho'vyakte śabda ukto'paśabdo'pyasphu ṭo'pi saḥ||72|| lacholāchi rlakṣaṇe syādicchāyāṃ vāchiriṣyate| āyāme syādāchiratha lajjāyāṃ hī ca īritaḥ||73|| hurchā proktastu kauṭilye kauṭilyamapasarpaṇam| maitreya āha murchāstu sanucchrāye ca mohane||74|| sphurchā ssyādvistṛtau yucchaṛ pramāde'thochi ruñchane| uñchaḥ kaṇaśa ādānaṃ kaṇiśādyārjanaṃ silam||75|| iti yādavakośasya prāmāṇyāduñcha uñchanam| uchīrvivāse saṃproktassamāptiḥ prāyaśo hyayam||76|| vipūrvassyā drama gatau dhrajadhrajidhṛjādhṛjiḥ| dhvajadhvajīcātha kūjo'vyakte śabde samīritaḥ||77|| arjaṣṣarjaścārjane syāggarja śśabde'tha tarjatiḥ| bhartsane syātkarjati stu vyathane kharja pūjane||78|| ajo gatau śrepaṇe ca pālane tejatismṛtaḥ| khajo manthe khajistu syādgativaikalya ejṛtu||79|| kampane'thoṭu o sphūrja vajranirghoṣa īritaḥ| kṣissyātkṣaye'karmako'yamajantaḥ parikīrtitaḥ||80|| ṇyartho'syāntarbhāvitastu sakarmaka udāhṛtaḥ| avyaktaśabde kṣījo'yaṃ kūjinā paṭhituṃ kṣamaḥ||81|| lajolaji rbharjane syāllājo lājiśca bhartsane| jajojajiśca yuddhe syāddhiṃsāyāṃ tuja ucyate||82|| pālane syāttujiśśabde gajo gajigṛjau gṛjiḥ| mujo mujiścātra gajo madane ca prakīrtitaḥ||83||9 gatau vajavratau proktau tvanudāttānubandhakāḥ| ṣaṭ‌triṃśacchāḍhṛparyantāṣṭavargīyāntimā athā||84|| dhātuṣveteṣvādimasssayādaṭṭo'tikramahiṃsayoḥ| dopadho'yaṃ topadho'yamiti kecitpracakṣate||85|| veṣṭassyādveṣṭane ceṣṭaś‌ceṣṭāyāṃ goṣṭaloṣaṭatī| saṅghāte ghaṭṭa calane sphuṭo vikasane hyariḥ||86|| gatāvathaikacaryāyāṃ vaṭhirmaṭhikaṭhī ubhau| śoke ca cātrādhyānaṃ hi procyate pālane muṭhiḥ||87|| vibādhāyāṃ heṭhatissyādeṭhatiś‌ca hiḍistu saḥ| gatyanāgarayoḥ prokto huḍissaṅghātakarmaṇi||88|| kuḍirdāhe vaṇḍatiś‌ca maṇḍatiś‌ca vibhājane| paribhāṣāṇa ākhyāto bhaḍistu paribhāṣaṇam||89|| sa nindopālambhanaṃ ca parihāsaś‌ca kathyate| piḍissaṅghāta udito mārjane muḍirucyate||90|| nyagbhāvaścāpi śuddhiśca mārjanaṃ parikīrtitam| tuḍi stu toḍane prok‌ta stoḍanaṃ ceha kathyate||91|| dāraṇaṃ hiṃsanaṃ cātha huḍirvaraṇakarmaṇi| svīkāro varaṇaṃ proktaṃ haraṇaṃ ca pare jaguḥ||92|| caḍi kope rujāyāṃ ca saṅghāte ca śaḍissmṛtaḥ| taḍistu kāḍane prokto gatau paḍi rudāhṛtaḥ||93|| kaḍirmade khaḍirmanthe huḍṛ hoḍṛ anādare| āplavyārthe dāḍṛmato sabaśādiśca sammataḥ||94|| āplavyantvāplavo drāḍṛ prokto viśaraṇe tathā| dhrāḍṛ cātha bhavecchāḍṛ ślāghāyāṃ kramatastataḥ||95|| aṣṭavargīyāntapūrte parasmaipadinastu te| ṣaḍaśītiśśauṭṭa garve yauṭṛ bandhe prakīrtitaḥ||96|| unmāde mreṭṛ camre ḍṛmle ṭṛḍānto dvitīyakaḥ| paṭhito'yaṃ nāthativaṭṭāntamadhye'rthasāmyataḥ||97|| varṣāvaraṇayo ssyāttu kaṭe keciccaṭe iti| datāvaṭapaṭau syātāṃ raṭa ssyātparibhāṣaṇe||98|| laṭo bālye viśaraṇarujāgatyavasādane| iṣyate śaṭatiḥ prājñairveṣṭane vaṭa ucyate||99|| trāse kiṭakhaṭau proktāvubhau śiṭaṣiṣṭau tu tau| anādare jaṭajhaṭau saṅghāte bhaṭatirbhṛtau||100|| ucchrāye taṭatiḥ proktaḥ kāṅkṣāyāṃ khaṭati ssmṛtaḥ| ṇaṭo nṛttau piṭaśśabde saṅghāte ca haṭastu saḥ||101|| dīptau ṣaṭastvavayave luṭastu syādviloḍane| ḍānto'yamityāhuraṇye parapreṣye ciṭassmṛtaḥ||102|| viṭaśśabde biṭaḥ prok‌taḥ ākrośe'sau baśādikaḥ| hiṭetyeke prāhuriṭaḥ kiṭaścāpi kaṭīrgatau||103|| tṛtīyamiti taṃ prāhuḥ kecidanyetviī iti| praśliṣya dhātudvitayamanyadāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ||104|| bhūṣāyāṃ maḍirākhyātaḥ kuṭirvaikalya karmaṇi| puḍaḥ pruḍo mardane syāgṛdalpībhāve cuḍissmṛtaḥ||105|| khaṇḍane muḍi rākhyātaḥ puḍi cetyaparake jaguḥ| proktau ruṭi luṭisteya eke ruṭhi luṭhī iti||106|| prāhuḥ pare ruḍiluṭī sphuṭirviśaraṇe smṛtaḥ| iti taṃ bruvate kecid‌vyaktavāci paṭhassamṛtaḥ||107|| vaṭhassthaulye samudito maṭho madanivāsayoḥ| prokto budhaiḥ kaṭhaḥ kṛcchrajīvane paribhāṣaṇe||108|| raṭaḥ prokto raṭhetyeke haṭhaḥ plutiśaṭhatvayoḥ| eke balātkāra iti prāha ruṭhaluṭhāvuṭha||109|| trayassyurupaghātārthā ūṭhetyeke vadanti hi| saṃkleśane ca hiṃsāyāṃ piṭhassyātkaitavepi ca||110|| śaṭhaśśuṭhastvatra bhavetpratighāte śuṭhīti tu| svāmī prāha tathaiva syātkuṭhiś‌cātraiva karmaṇ||111|| pratighāte'pi cālasye luṭhissyācchoṣaṇe śuṭhiḥ| ruṭhirluṭhirgatau bhāvakaraṇe cuḍḍa ucyate||112|| tad‌bhāvakāraṇaṃ prāhurabhiprāyasya sūcanam| aḍḍo'bhiyoga kakārkaśyerkaḍḍa cuḍḍādayastrayaḥ||113|| bhavanti copadhāḥ krīḍṛ vihāre tuḍṛ toḍane| prāhureke tūḍṛ iti gatau huḍṛ ca huḍṛ ca||114|| hoḍṛ cāpi bhavedrauḍṛ loḍṛ tvanādaraṇakarmaṇi| unmāde syādroḍṛ loḍṛ hyaḍastūdyamane smṛtaḥ||115|| vilāse laḍatiḥ prokto ḍalayorlalayorapi| aikyāllaleti dhātuñca prāhussvāmyādayaḥ param||116||| kaḍo made kaḍiriti pare prāhurgaṭistviha| vaktraikadeśa ākhyātaḥ pavargīyākṣarāntimāḥ||17|| stobhatyantāścatustriśadanudāttānubandhakāḥ| tipṛte pṛṣṭe pṛṣṭe pṛkṣaraṇārthā ihādimaḥ||118|| anudāttassmṛtaḥ kṣīrasvāmī babhrāma seḍiti| tepṛtiḥ kampane ca syādgalepṛ udīritaḥ||119|| ṭu vepṛ kampane proktaḥ kepṛ glepṛ gepṛ ca| cātkampane gatau ceti svāmī sūtravibhāgataḥ||120|| maitreyastu paṭhitvā camantareṇeha kampane| ityapekṣata ityāha glepatistvarthabhedataḥ||121|| paṭhyate'sau punarmepṛ repṛ lepṛ gatau smṛtāḥ| trapūṣṣyādiha lajjāyāṃ kapiścalana ucyate||22|| rabirlabi rabiśśabde'vasasre ca labi ssmṛtaḥ| kabṛ varṇe hyadhāṣṭarye tu klībṛ kṣībṛ made smṛtaḥ||123|| rebhṛ śabdakriyāyāṃ syātthane śībhṛ cībhṛ ca| abhiḥ kvacidrabiścāpi paṭhyate'thaṣṭabhisskabhiḥ||124|| pratibandhe stambhateṣṭaṃ kecidāhurnisargajam| bhavejjabhūrjṛbhirgātravināme śalbhakatthane||125|| valbhassyād‌bhojane dantoṣṭhayādirdhāṣṭarye tu galbhatiḥ| śrambhuḥ pramāde dantyādistālavyādiśca sammataḥ||126|| ṣṭubhu sstambe hyathātra syuḥ parasmaipadidhātavaḥ| ekacatvāriṃśadamī gupvādyāssimbhupaścimāḥ||127|| rakṣaṇe syād‌gupūrdhūpa ssantāpe japajalpatī| vyak‌tāyāṃ vāci japatirmānase ca prakīrtitaḥ||128|| sāntvane dapitiḥ proktassamavāye ṣapassmṛtaḥ| samavāyastu sambandho'vabodhassamyageva vā||129|| vyaktāyāṃ vāci rapatirlapatiśca prakīrtitaḥ| gatau cupastu mandāyāṃ hiṃsāyāmatha kīrtitāḥ||130|| tupa tumpau trupa trumpau trupha tumbhau trupha stataḥ| trumphaścaiṣu dvāvādyau ca pañcamāṣṣaṣṭha eva ca||131|| nīrephāssyussarephāstu pare catvāra ādimāḥ| prathamāntā dvitīyāntāḥ pare'ṣṭau sāva īritāḥ||132|| parpora pharaphī arbaḥ parbo larbaśca barbatiḥ| marbaḥ karbaḥ kharbagarvau śarbaṣarvau ca carbatiḥ||133|| gatāvādyo'trādimānto dvitīyāntāvubhau tataḥ| ekādaśa tṛtīyāntāstato muktvā dvitīyakam||134|| tṛtīyaṃ ca smṛtāssarve sarephā atra daṇḍake| ācchādane kubiḥ prokto'rdane lubitubī matau||135|| cubi ssyādvastrasaṃyoge ṣṛbhu ṣṛmbhu tu hiṃsane| ṣibhu ṣimbhu iti pare śubhaśśumbhaśca bhāṣaṇe||136|| imau bhāsana ityeke hiṃsāyāmiti cāpare| athānunāsikāntā ssyuranudāttānubandhakāḥ||137|| kamvantā daśaghiṇyādyā grahaṇe syād ghiṇirghuṇiḥ| ghṛṇiścātha ghṛṇo ghūrṇo bhramaṇe parikīrtitau||138|| parasmaipadināvetau tudādau tu bhaviṣyataḥ| vyavahāre stutau cāpi paṇassyātpana ca stutau||139|| bhāmaḥ krodhe kṣamūṣ tu syātsahane'tha bhavetkamuḥ| kāntāvicchātra kāntissyātparasmaipadinastataḥ||140|| kramyantāstriṃśaducyante hyaṇo raṇavaṇau bhaṇaḥ| maṇaḥ kaṇaśca kvaṇati vraṇati bhraṇati dhvaṇāḥ||141|| śabdārthāssyurdhaṇo'pyatra budhaiḥ keścitprapaṭhyate| ihānayane tvoṇṛ śoṇṛ varṇe gatāvapi||142|| saṅghāte śoṇṛ tu bhavecch‌loṇṛ coktā amī trayaḥ| tālavyoṣmādayaśśoṇādayaḥ paiṇṛ gatau tathā||143|| preraṇe śleṣaṇe ca syātkvacitpraiṇriti paṭhyate| dhaṇaśśabde hyayaṃ nānta upadeśe smṛto budhaiḥ||144|| kecid‌baṇetyapi kanīrdīptikāntigatiṣvatha| ṣṭano vanaśca śabde syātsambhaktau tu vanaṣṣaṇaḥ||145|| amo gatyādiṣu gatau dramo hammaśca mīmṛ ca| mīmṛ śabde cātha ca muścha murja mujha mū tathā||146|| adane syurjimiṃ kecitpaṭhantyatha bhavetkramuḥ| pādavakṣepe'tha revatyantā ayatipūrvakāḥ||147|| saptatriṃśadudīryante hyanudāttānubandhakāḥ| gatāvayo vayapayau mayaś‌ca yata yauṇayaḥ||148|| dāne gatau rakṣaṇe ca hiṃsanādānayordayaḥ| ādānaṃ grahaṇaṃ proktaṃ kathyate'tha gatau rayaḥ||149|| ūyī ssyāttantusantāne pūyīrviśaraṇe tatā| durgandhe cātha śabde syātkrūyī runde ca sa smṛtaḥ||150|| kṣmāyīrvidhūnena vṛddhau sphāyyopyāyī ca kathyate| santāne pālane tāyṛ prabandhassa tu gadyate||151|| śalassaṃvaraṇe caiva calane ca prakīrtitaḥ| valavallau saṃvaraṇe syātāṃ sañcaraṇe'pi ca||152|| malo mallo dhāraṇe syāt bhalabhallau tu hiṃsane| ādānakarmamaṇi paribhāṣaṇe ca prakīrtitau||153|| kalaśśabde ca saṃkhyāne'vyakte śabde tu kallatiḥ| svāmītvaśabda ityāha tūṣṇībhāvassa ityapi||154|| devane tevṛ devṛ syāt savane ṣevṛ gevṛ ca| glevṛpevṛmlevṛmevṛcātrānyassetistvayam||155|| bravūte sopadeśo'pītyevaṃ nyāsakṛdādayaḥ| tadetadvacanaṃ bhāṣyaviruddhamiti manmahe||156|| prāhireke śevṛkhevṛkevrityapi budhottamāḥ| revṛ tu syātplavagatau sā tu plutagatirmatā||157|| parasmaipadino'vāntā navati syuṣ‌ṣaḍuttarā| bandhane mavyatissūrkṣyerkṣya īrṣyaśca te trayaḥ||158|| īrṣyārthā ssyurhayo gatyāṃ śucyo'bhiṣavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| somāṅgānāṃ praśithilīkaraṇaṃ snanameva vā||159|| sandhānaṃ vā surāyāścābhiṣavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| eke cucya iti prāhurharyaḥ kāntau gatau smṛtaḥ||160|| bhūṣaṇe vāraṇe cāpi paryāptau cāla īritaḥ| svarite dayamityeke phalā viśaraṇe sa ñīt||161|| mīlaśmīlausmīlatiśca kṣmīlatiśca nimaṣaṇe| nimeṣaṇaṃ tu saṅkocastālavyādirdvitīyakaḥ||162|| dantyādiś‌ca tṛtīyassyātpratiṣṭambhe'tha pīlatiḥ| pratiṣṭambho rodhanaṃ syānnīlo varṇe prakīrtitaḥ||163|| śīlaḥ samādhau vijñeyaḥ kīlo bandhana īritaḥ| kūla āvaraṇe śīlo rujāsaṅghoṣayo ssmṛtaḥ||164|| bhavettūlastu niṣkarṣe sa tu niṣkoṣaṇaṃ smṛtam| antargatasya taccāpi bahirnassāraṇaṃ matam||165|| saṅghāte pūla ākhyātaḥ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu mūlatiḥ| niṣpattau phalatirbhāvakaraṇe culla iṣyate||166|| tātparyāviṣkṛtirbhāvakaraṇaṃ budhasammatam| phullo vikāso śaithilye cillo bhāvakṛtāvapi||167|| gatau tilasyāttilleti kecidāhuḥ paraṃ budhāḥ| velṛcelṛtathā kelṛkhelṛkṣvelṛ ca vellatiḥ||168|| calane pañca ṛditaṣṣaṣṭho lopadha ucyate| velṛphelṛtathā śelṛ gatau pelriti kecana||169|| skhalassaṃcalane proktassaṃcaye khala īritaḥ| galo'dane ṣalo gatyāṃ dalo viśaraṇe smṛtaḥ||170|| śvalaśvallāvāśugatau kolṛkhorṛtathā gateḥ| pratighāte dhorṛ gati cāturye parikīrtitaḥ||171|| tsaraśchadmagatau prokto hūrchane karma ucyate| abhravabhraumabhracarau gatyarthāścarati stu saḥ||172|| bhakṣaṇe'pi bhavedatra ṣṭhipurnirasanakriyaḥ| asya dvitīyastha ṣṭho vetyevaṃ vadati vṛttikṛt||173|| jirjaye'yamajanteṣu yujyate paṭhituṃ jayaḥ| utkarṣaprāptirākhyāto'karmako'yamiheryate||174|| prāṇānāṃ dhāraṇe jīvaḥ pīvamīvāvubhau tathā| tīvanīvau smṛtau sthaulye kṣīvu kṣevū narāsane||175|| urvīsturvi stathā thurvī rdurvīrdhurvī sca hiṃsane| gurvīrudyamane murvī rbandhane parikīrtitaḥ||176|| pūraṇe parvaparvau ca marvaścāthā'dane smṛtaḥ| carvo bharvastu hiṃsāyāṃ karvaḥ kharvaśca garvatiḥ||177|| darpeṣathārvaśsarṣarvau hiṃsāyāṃ parikīrtitāḥ| ivirvyāptau pivi mivi ṇivayassecane smṛtāḥ||178|| mūrdhanyoṣmādirityeke tṛtīyamiha cakṣate| anyo'rthassevana iti taraṅgiṇyāmudāhṛtaḥ||179|| hivirdivirdhivijivī prīṇanārthāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| ravīravirdhaviścaiva gatyarthāḥ kathitā ime||180|| hiṃsākaraṇayoś‌ca syātkṛtaviścāttu gatau smṛtaḥ| svādau ca paṭhyate so'yaṃ bandhane mava iṣyate||181|| avassyādrakṣaṇe gatyāṃ kāntiprītyośca tarpaṇe| tathāvagamane caiva praveśe śravaṇe'pi ca||182|| svāmyarthayācane caiva kriyecchāyāṃ tathaiva ca| dīptāvavāptau ca tathā'liṅgane hiṃsane'p ca||183|| ādāne caiva bhāge ca vṛddhau ca parikīrtitaḥ| dhāvustu syād‌gatau śuddhau svaritedayamiṣyate||184|| ekapañcāśadīṣmāntā ātmanepadinastataḥ| sandīpane kleśane ca jīvane dhukṣa dhikṣatī||185|| vṛkṣassyādvaraṇe vidyopādānakarmaṇi| lābhe'lābhe ca bhikṣāyāṃ bhikṣassyātkleśati stuḥ saḥ||186|| avyaktāyāṃ vāci bhaveddurga ityāha bādhane| vṛddhau śīghrārthe ca dakṣo mauṇḍyejyayo stathā||187|| vratādeśopanayananiyameṣu prakīrtitaḥ| īkṣo darśane cāpi bhāṣastu vyaktāyāṃ vāci kathyate||188|| darśane cāpi bhāṣastu vyaktāyāṃ vāci kathyate| varṣassyātsnehane dantyoṣṭhyādirgeṣu tu kathyate||||189|| anvicchāyāṃ sātrabhavedanveṣaṇamihāpare| gleṣrityāhuḥ peṣṛ bhavetprayatne jeṣṛṇeṣṛ ca||190|| eṣṛpreṣṛca gatyārthā reṣṛheṣṛ ca heṣṛ ca| avyak‌te śabda ādyo'tra vṛka śabde prakīrtitaḥ||191|| dvādaśvaśabde śabdasya kutsāyāṃ kāsṛ kīrtitaḥ| bhāsṛdīptauṇāsṛrāsṛ śabde'tha kulitvavāk||192|| ṇaso bhaved‌bhya sa bhaya icchāyāṃ śasi rāṅyutaḥ| grasurglasu ścādane syācceṣṭāyāmīha iṣyate||193|| bahirmahiś‌ca vṛddhau syādgatā pahi rudāhṛtaḥ| garho galhaś‌ca kutsāyāṃ prādhānye barha balhatī||194|| oṣṭhayādimāvimauvarho valhaś‌ca paribhāṣaṇe| hiṃsācchādanayo ścemau dantyeṣṭhyādi prakīrtitau||195|| kecittu pūrvayordantyoṣṭhyāditvamanayo stu te| oṣṭhyāditvamapi prāhurgatau lpiha udāhṛtaḥ||196|| prayatne vehṛjehṛsyābdāhṛ caiteṣvapaścima| dantyoṣṭhyādiḥ paścimastu kevaloṣṭhyādiriṣyate||197|| oṣṭhyādī dvāvapītyeke dantyoṣṭhyādī itītare| gatau ca jehatirnidrā kṣayedrāhṛ samīritaḥ||198|| prāhurnikṣepa ityeke kāśṛ dīptau prakīrtitaḥ| ūho vitarke gāhūstu viloḍana udāhṛtaḥ||199|| gṛhūrgrahaṇa ākhyāto glahaścātha ghuṣirbudhaiḥ| ucyate kāntikaraṇe kecidatra ghaṣetyapi||200|| paṭhantyakāropadhakamucyante'rhati paścimāḥ| parasmaipadabhājo'nye navatirdhātavaḥ kramāt||201|| aviśabdana ākhyāto ghuṣir tattu viśabdanam| pratijñānaṃ tato'nyasminnartha ityeka ucire||202|| paṭheranye śabda iti vyāptāvakṣū stanūkṛtau| takṣūstvakṣūśca samproktassecane tūkṣa iṣyate||203|| rakṣastu pālane ṇikṣaś‌cambune parikīrtitaḥ| tṛkṣastṛkṣaśca ṇakṣaśca gatyarthāssamudīritāḥ||204|| vakṣoroṣebhavedeke saṅghāta iti cakṣate| saṅghāte mṛkṣa ākhyāto mrakṣa ityeka ūcire||205|| takṣa ssyāttvacane tattu bhavetsaṃvaṇaṃ tvacaḥ| grahaṇaṃ ceha pakṣassyātparigraha itītare||206|| sūrkṣassyādādare sūrkṣo'nādare syāditi kvacit| apapāṭhastato'vajñāvahelanamasūrkṣaṇam||207|| ityuktamamareṇāpi kākṣirvākṣiś‌camāṅkṣatiḥ| kāṅkṣāyāṃ syurathadrākṣi rdhākṣa rdhvākṣiśca dāruṇe||208|| vāśite cātha cūṣassyātpāne tuṣṭau tu tūṣatiḥ| vūṣo vṛddhau bhavenmūṣasteye lūṣati rūṣatī||209|| bhūṣāyāṃ prasave śūṣe'bhyanajñā parsavo hyayam| tālavyoṣmādimoyūṣo hiṃsāyāṃ jūṣa ca smṛtaḥ||210|| alaṅkāre bhūṣa ūṣo rujāyāmīṣa uñchane| kaṣaḥ khaṣaśśiṣajaṣau jhaṣa śśaṣavaṣau maṣaḥ||211|| ruṣo riṣaśca hiṃsārthā stutīyaṣṣaṣṭha eva ca| tālavyoṣmādimau prok‌tau dantyoṣṭhyādistu saptamaḥ||212|| śiṣo'nudātte'tra bhavedbhartsane bhaṣa ucyate| bhartsanaṃ śvaravaḥ prokto uṣo dāhe prakīrtitaḥ||213|| jiṣurviṣurmiṣu ścaiva secane samudīritāḥ| viṣussyādanudātto'tra phuṣaḥ ṣaṣṭau śriṣuśśliṣuḥ||214|| pruṣuḥ pluṣuś‌ca dāhe syusseḍayaṃ śleṣati smṛtaḥ| daivādikasya grahaṇamaniṭkeṣviti cakṣate||215|| kaiyaṭādyā nyāsakṛtā dvayorgrahaṇamiṣyate| aniṭ‌keṣviti yatproktaṃ tattu svoktivirodhataḥ||216|| gadranthāntaravirodhāccā'pyupekṣyamiti manmahe| pṛṣurvṛṣu rmṛṣuścaiva secane parikīrtitāḥ||217|| sahane ca mṛṣurhiṃsā kleśayoścāparau matau| ghṛṣussaṅgharṣa udito'līke hṛṣurūdīritaḥ||218|| tusa hrasau hlasa rasau śabde saṃparikīrtitāḥ| lasassyācchraleṣaṇe caiva krīḍane cādane ghaslṛ||219|| jarjaścaryo jharjhatiśca paribhāṣaṇa hiṃsayoḥ| tarjane ca samākhyātāḥ pisṛ pesṛ gatau smṛtau||220|| hase stu hasane proktassamādhau ṇiśa īritaḥ| tālavyoṣmāntimo'yaṃ syānmiśaśca maśatistithā||221|| śabde roṣakṛte caṭa syāttālavyoṣmāntimāvimau| dantyoṣṭhyāntaśśavastālavyoṣmādajirgatibodhakaḥ||222|| tālavyoṣmādyantimo'yaṃ śaśaḥpluta gatau mataḥ| hiṃsāyāṃ śasurākhyāto dantyeṣmāntassa sammataḥ||223|| śaṃsusstutāvimaṃ durgo durgatāvapi vāñchati| parikalkana ākhyātaś‌cahaśśāṭhyaṃ tu kalkanam||224|| śabde ca bṛṃhatiḥ prok‌to rahastyāge rahirgatau| dṛho dṛhi bṛha bṛhi vṛddhau samparikīrtitāḥ||225|| śabde ca bṛṃhatiḥ prokto bṛhirityeka ūcire| tuhurduhi ruhirproktā ardane'rhastu pūjane||226|| anudātteta ākhyātāḥ kṛpvantāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ| dyutodīptauśvitā varṇe ñimidā snehane smṛtaḥ||227|| ñiṣvadā snehane caiva mocane ca prakīrtitaḥ| sthāne mocanaśabdasya mohanaṃ kecidūcire||228|| ñikṣvidācetyeka āhurathadīptau rucassmṛtaḥ| abhiprītau cātha bhaved ghoṭatiḥ parivartane||229|| ruṭoluṭoṭhāś‌caite pratighāte prakīrtitāḥ| śubho dīptau sañcalane kṣubho na bhatu bhautu tau||230|| hiṃsāyāṃ kathitāvādya stvabhāve'pi bhavedimau| krayādau divādau ca gaṇe dṛśyate rūpabhadetaḥ||231|| sraṃ surdhvaṃsuśca bhraṃsuścāvasaṃsana udīritāḥ| dhvaṃsurgatau cātra peṭhurbhraṃśurityapi kecana||232|| anye tṛtīyamevātra tālavyāntaṃ pracakṣate| divādau syād bhraṃśu rbhaṃśuradhaḥ patana ityapi||233|| viśvāse tu bhavetsrambhurdantyādirayamucyate| tālavyādirgatasso'yaṃ pramāde kathitaḥ purā||234|| vṛtu ssyādvartane vṛddhau vṛdhu śśabdasya kutsane| śṛdhuḥ prasravaṇau syandū ssyātsāmarthye kṛpūssmṛtaḥ||235|| dyutādeś‌ca vṛtādeśca samāptidyotanāyavṛt| tvaratyantāṣvito'tha syuranudāttānubandhakāḥ||236|| trayodaśaḥ syustatrādau ceṣṭāyāṃ ghaṭa ucyate| bhaye sañcalane'pi syād‌vyādhaḥ prakhyānakarmaṇi||237|| kathyate prathatistadvatpraso vistāra ucyate| mrado mardane ākhyāta sskadasskadanakarmaṇi||238|| vidrāvaṇaṃ syātkadanaṃ kṣajastu gatidānayoḥ| dakṣo gatau hiṃsane cāpyayaṃ prāggatiśaighyrayoḥ||239|| anudāttetsu paṭhito mittvāyānūdyate punaḥ| krapaḥ kṛpāyāṃ gamane kandatiḥ krandatiḥ kladiḥ||240|| vaiklabyavācakā kecidvaikalya iti cakṣate| trīnapyanidito nandī prāha svāmīditaḥ punaḥ||241|| syātāṃ kadi kradī atreditāvanidito kradaḥ| kladaś‌cetyapi maitreyo viśeṣaṃ manyate'tra saḥ||242|| kadikradyoḥ klandateś‌ca parasmaipadidhātuṣu| āhvāne rodane caiva proktānāṃ punaratra tu||243|| mittvātmanepadārtho'yaṃ pāṭho ñīttu tvarā iha| sambhrame syādiha ghaṭādayaṣṣita udīritāḥ||244|| phaṇāntā atha kathyante parasmaipadinaḥ kramāt| jvaro roge secane tu gaḍo heḍa stu veṣṭane||245|| anudāttetsu yaḥ pūrvaṃ gatau heḍṛ anādare| ityasāveva muktānubandho'rthasya prabhedataḥ||246|| anūdyate'tra mittvārthaṃ jvarādi gaṇataḥ pṛthak| anuvādaṃ vihāyaitanmadhyabhāge'nuvādajāt||247|| sāmarthyād bhavati hyasmātparasmaipadamatra ca| vaṭo bhaṭaścāpi bhavetparibhāṣaṇakarmaṇi||248|| vaṭa vaṣṭena ityevaṃ yau prāgbhāṭabhṛtāviti| uditāvatra mittvārthaṃ paribhāṣaṇa eva hi||249|| anūdyete naṭo nṛttāvitthameva puroditaḥ| bodhyo vivekastatrā'yaṃ bhavedyeṣu naṭā iti||250|| vyapadesastu vākyārthābhinayātmakanāṭyakam‌| tatpūrvaṃ paṭhitasyārtho yatkāriṣu bhavetpunaḥ||251|| nartakavyapadeśastatpadārthābhinayātmakam| nṛtyaṃ yadagātravikṣepasūtrarūpaṃ tu nṛttakam||252|| yattaccāpi ghaṭādisthanaṭaterartha īritaḥ| kecid‌ghaṭādau tu naṭo natāviti paṭhanti hi||253|| natāvityapareṇopadeśe bhāṣyakṛtā punaḥ| nāṭīti dīrghasya pāṭhādghaṭādau naṭati stvayam||254|| syaṇṇopadeśa eveti bruvate sarvasūrayaḥ| ṣṭakastu pratighāte syāccakastṛptau prakīrtitaḥ||255|| ya stṛptau pratighāte ca paṭhitaḥ prāckako hyasau| anūdyate tṛptimātre mittvahetorgaṇe tviha||256|| ātmanepadināṃ madhye paṭhitasya punastviha| anuvādasya sāmarthyātparasmaipadameva hi||257|| kakhe tu hasane prokta śśaṅkāyāmucyate rage| lage saṅge hrage caiva hlage caiva ṣage ṣṭhage||258|| catvārassyuḥ saṃvaraṇe viśeṣānnocyate kage| ako'gaś‌ca bhavetāntau kuṭilāyāṃ gatāvubhau||259|| gatau kaṇa raṇau syātāmatha dāne ca kīrtitaḥ| caṇaśśaṇa śśraṇa ścānye prāhuśśaṇa gatāviti||260|| śratha kratha krathā ś‌caiva klatho hiṃsārthakā ssmṛtāḥ| canaś‌cātha vanuścaiva nocyate dīpane jvalaḥ||261|| ṇārthaṃ paṭhiṣyamāṇo'yaṃ mittvāyā'nūdyate tviha| hvala hyalau tu calana ādhyāne smṛ prakīrtyate||262|| cintāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇasyād‌dhyāne mittvāya saṅgrahaḥ| autkaṇṭhyapūrvaṃ smaraṇamādhyānamiha kathyate||263|| dṛ syādbhaye kyrādistho mittvāyānūdyate tviha| śrā ssyātpāke kṛtā tvasya śrotaś‌cānukṛtistviyam||264|| jñā ssyānminmāraṇe caiva toṣaṇe ca niśāmane| niśāmanaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ syājjñānamityāha mādhavaḥ||266|| jñānamātramiti tvanye niśāneṣviti cāparaḥ| pāṭho'pi dṛśyate tacca tīkṣṇīkaraṇamīritam||267|| calatiḥ kampane mistyācchadassyādūrjane tu mit| svārthaṇyabhāve mittvārthaṃ caurādika ihoccate||268|| ūrje rarthe vṛttiras.ya dhātorbahrthakatvataḥ| vilāse paṭhitaḥ prāṅgimatsyājjihvonmathane laṅaḥ||269|| jñāpanaṃ syādunmathanaṃ madīstu glepane tathā| harṣe ca mitsyāddainyaṃ hi glepanaṃ samudīritam|||270|| daivādikasya mittvārthamanuvādo'sya kīrtitaḥ| dhvanaśśabde bhāvyayaṃ hi mittvāyānūdyate tviha||271|| dalirvali sskhaliraṇī dhvaniśca trapi reva ca| kṣapi śceti papāṭhatra bhojastatra dhvano raṇaḥ||272|| dalatadi rvalati ścaiva skhalati strapatistathā| gatāsteṣāṃ ṇici hrasvo bhavati kṣaiḥ kṣaye punaḥ||273|| nirdiśyate vakṣyamāṇaḥ pugāgamapurassaraḥ| svano'vataṃsane vakṣyamāṇo mittvārthamucyate||274|| ghaṭādayo mita iti gaṇasūtramidaṃ matam| janī jṛṣ krasu rañjo mantāśceti tvaparaṃ matam||275|| kecidatra knaso sthāne paṭhanti ṣṇasumeva hi| jvalahvalahyala namāmupasargasamāgamam||276|| vihāya vartamānānāṃ vikalpānmittvamiṣyate| vinopasargaṃ mittvaṃ vā glāsnāvanuvamāpi ca||277|| na kamyamicamāṃ mittvaṃ śamo'darśana īritam| na mittvaṃ syādiha yamo'pariveṣaṇakarmaṇi||278|| skhaderavaparibhyāṃ ca parasyeha tu neṣyate| apātparasyāpi mittvaṃ nyasakāro nahīcchati||279|| phaṇo gatau mid‌bhavati ghaṭādeḥ pūrtaye'travṛt| phaṇātpūrvaṃ vṛdityeke vadantīha manīṣiṇaḥ||280|| svaritedrājṛ dīptau syādanudāttānubandhakāḥ| bhrājṛbhrāśṛbhlāśṛdīptau trayo'pi dvita īritāḥ||281|| dvitīyaścatṛtīyaśca tālavyāntau prakīrtitau| syamvādayaḥ kṣaratyantāḥ parasmaipadino matāḥ||282|| syamu ssvano dhvanaśśabde ṣamaśca ṣṭamatistathā| avaikalye jvalo dīptau calaḥ kamapana īritaḥ||283|| jala ssyād‌ghātane taikṣṇ‌yaṃ ghātanaṃ procyate budhaiḥ| ṭalaṭ‌valau tu vaiklabye ṣṭalassthāne prakīrtitaḥ||284|| vilekhane halo gandhe ṇalo bandhana ityapi| kecidāhuḥ palo gatyāṃ balaḥ prāṇanakarmaṇi||285|| dhānyāvarodhane ca syānmahattve pula ucyate| bandhuṣvapi ca saṃstyāne kula ukto'tra bandhunā||286|| tad‌vyāpāro lakṣyate hi saṃstyānaṃ tvihaṃ saṃhatiḥ| śalo hulaḥ pallṛ ca syurgātau niṣpākakarmaṇi||287|| kvathe pathe ti gatyāṃ syānmathe tu syādviloḍane| ṭu vamussyādudgiraṇe bhrama stu calane smṛtaḥ||288|| kasantā atha samproktāḥ parasmaipadinaḥ kramāt| ṣad‌laniṭko viśaraṇe gatāvapyavasādane||290|| śad‌laniṭkaśśātane'yaṃ viśīrṇatvasya bodhakaḥ| nirdiśyate śātanaṃ tu viṣayatvena samprati||291|| āhvāne redane cāniṭ kruśo'tha syādidhakocatiḥ| samparcane ca kauṭilye pratiṣṭambhe vilekhane||292|| budhopagamane'tha syād bījajanmanyaniḍuhaḥ| prādurbhāva ca gatyāṃ syātkaso vṛtkaraṇaṃ tviha||293|| jvalādigaṇasampūrtibodhanāya prakīrtatam| gūhatyantā athocyante svaritetohyanukramāt||294|| hikko'vyakte śabda ukto'ñcustu gatyāṃ ca yācane| acu ityeka āhiścāpare'ciriti cakṣate||295|| yāñcāyāṃ tu ṭu yācṛ syādreṭṛ syātparibhāṣaṇe| cate dade yācane'tha paryāptau prodhṛ kīrtyate||296|| medhāyāṃ hiṃsane caiva midṛmedṛ ca kīrtitau| thāntāvimāviti svāmī prāha nyāsastu dhāntimau||297|| medhṛ ssyātsahgame cātha ṇidṛṇedṛ ca kutsane| sannikarṣe cātha śṛdhurmudhuścondana īritau||298|| unda saṃkledanaṃ proktaṃ budhir bodhana īritaḥ| nisāmane tūbundira syādveṇṛ syājjhānacintayoḥ||299|| gatau niśāmane caiva vāditragrahaṇe'pi ca| nānto'yamupadeśe'tha khanussyādavadhāraṇe||300|| ādānasaṃvaraṇayoś‌cīvṛ syādatha cāyṛ tu| syātpujāyāṃ niśamane gatau vyaya udīritaḥ||301|| dāśṛ dāne bheṣṛ bhayo gatāvityapare jaguḥ| bhreṣṛ bhleṣṛgatau syātāmaso dīpt‌yāṃ gatau tathā||302|| ādāne caiṣa ṣānto'pi spaśassparśanabādhayoḥ| sparśanaṃ grathanaṃ proktaṃ laṣaḥ kāntau prakīrtitaḥ||303|| caṣo bhakṣaṇa ākhyāto hiṃsāyāṃ chaṣatirjhaṣaḥ| ādānasaṃvaraṇayorbhrakṣa bhlakṣāvathādane||304|| bhakṣa ityāha maitreyo dāśṛ dāne prakīrtitaḥ| māhra māne saṃvaraṇe guhūrathaṅitaḥ kramāt||305|| ajantāḥ pañca kathyante śriñ sevāyāṃ prakīrtitaḥ| bharaṇe bhṛñ hrañharaṇe dhāraṇe dhṛñprakathyate||306|| ṇīñī prāpaṇe bhṛñādyāstu catvāro'niṭa īritāḥ| parasmaipadino'jantāḥ kathyante'thānupūrvyataḥ||307|| dheṭ pāne syāttathā glaimlairharṣakṣaya udīritau| dhātukṣayo'tra vidvadbhirharṣakṣayapadeditaḥ||308|| dyaissyādathanyakkaraṇe nyakkṛtistu tiriskriyā| drai ssyātsvapre bhave ddhai tu tṛptau dhyai cintane smṛtaḥ||309|| śabdasaṅghātayosstyaiṣṭ‌yai khadane khairbhavedatha| kṣai jai ṣai ca kṣaye proktāḥ kai ca gai śabda īritau||310|| śaiśrai pāke bhavetpraio vai ca śocaṇa karmaṇi| ṣṭai bhavedveṣṭane ṇṣai tu veṣṭane samudīritaḥ||311|| ṣṇaiśobhāyāṃ caiṣa bhavedityeke daiptu śodhane| pāḥ pāne ghrāstu gandhopādāne samparikīrtyate||312|| dhmāstu śabde'gnisaṃyoge'pi ca sadbhiḥ prakīrtitaḥ| ihīgnisaṃyoga ukto mukhavāyvagniyojanam||313|| gaternivṛttau ṣṭhāstu syānmanā ābhyāse prakathyate| dā dāne syāt hva kauṭilye svṛ syācchabdopatāpayoḥ||314|| smṛ cintāyāṃ saṃvaraṇe dvṛ bhavetsu gatau smṛtaḥ| ṛ syād‌gatiprāpaṇayoḥ secane gṛ ghṛ ca smṛtaḥ||315|| dhvṛ hūrchane hatau sru ṣṣuḥ prasavaiś‌varyayossmṛtaḥ| prasavastvabhyanujñānaṃ śravaṇe śruḥ prakīrtyate||316|| dhrusthairye syādgatau durdrurjijrī abhibhave smṛtau| nyūnikriyāvātha nyūnībhāvo vā'bhibhavassmṛtaḥ||317|| ādye sakarmako jñeyo'parasminnapyakarmakaḥ| dheḍādayo dhātavo'mī ajantā aniṭa ssmṛtāḥ||318|| ṅī ṅṅantā atha kathyante ātmanepadino ṅitaḥ| smiṅṅīṣaddhasane śabde'vyakte guṅ parikīrtyate||319|| gāṅ gatau kuṅghu ṅuṅcaiva ṅuṅca śabde prakīrtitaḥ| anye tahku ṅkhu ṅca guṅca ghuṅca dṛṅceti cakṣate||320|| cyuñj‌yu ṅ‌pru ṅ‌plu ṅīto jñeyāḥ kluṅjityeke paṭhanti hi| ruṅ syādgatau roṣaṇe ca proktaṃ hiṃsā hi roṣaṇam||321|| dhṛṅ syādapadhvaṃsane'tha praṇidāne smṛto hi meṅ| praṇidānaṃ vinimayaḥ pratyarpaṇamapīṣyate||322|| deṅ rakṣaṇe gatau śyaiṅ syātpyai ṅvaddhautraiṅ tu pālane| pavane pūṅ bandhane mūṅimsaṅjādyā aniṭo hyamī||323|| vihāya sā gatau ṅīṅ syātplavane taraṇe ca tṛḥ| parasmaipadyathāṣṭau syuranudāttānubandhakāḥ||324|| gupo gopana ākhyāto niśāne tija ucyate| mānastu pūjane prokto badho bandhanakarmaṇi||325|| rābhasye rabha ākhyāto ḍulabhaṣ prāptikarmaṇi| pariṣvaṅge ṣvañjha uktaḥ purīṣotsarjane hadaḥ||326|| rabhādayo'mī catvāro dhātavo'niṭa īritāḥ| parasmaipadino'tha syu rdhātavaṣṣoḍaśaḥ kramāt||327|| ñī tkṣivadāvyaktaśabde syātskandir syācchoṣaṇe gatau| yabho maithina ākhyāto ṇamuḥ prahvatvaśabdayoḥ||328|| gamlṛsṛplṛgatau syātāṃ yamastūparame smṛtaḥ| tapassantāpa ākhyātastyajo hānau prakīrtitaḥ||330|| ṣañjassaṅge'tha daṃśastu daśane prekṣaṇe dṛśir| kṛṣo vilekhane tattvākarṣaṇaṃ samudīritam||331|| bhasmīkaraṇa ākhyāto dahassyātsecane mihaḥ| skandādayo'mī aniṭaścaturdaśa ca sammatāḥ||332|| kito nivāse rogāpanayane ca prakathyate| prāyeṇāyaṃ vipūrvassyādathaikādaśa dhātavaḥ||333|| dānādayo vahatyantā ssavaritato yathākramam| dānassyātkhaṇḍane śānastejane samudāhṛtaḥ||334|| ḍupacaṣpāka ukto'tha samavāye ṣacassmṛtaḥ| sevāyāṃ syad‌bhajo rañjo rāga ākrośane śapaḥ||335|| tviṣo dīptau yajo devapūjāyāṃ saṅgateḥ kṛtau| dāne'tha ḍuvapo bījasantāne parikīrtitaḥ||336|| bījasantāśabdena kṣetre vikiraṇaṃ tathā| garbhādānaṃ ca sampoktaṃ chedane'pyayamiṣyate||337|| vahassyātprāpaṇe 'niṭkāḥ pacādyāṣṣaca varjitāḥ| nivāse syādvaso'yaṃ tu parasmaipadabhājanam||338|| veñbhavettantusantāne vyeñtu saṃvaraṇe smṛtaḥ| hveñ spardhāyāṃ ca śabde ca vasādyā aniṭo'khilāḥ||339|| veñādayastrayau ñittvātpadadvitayabhājanam| parasmaipadinau syātāmatha dvau vadati stayoḥ||340|| vyaktāyāṃ vācyatho vṛddhau ṭu o śvi ssyādgatāvapi| yajādigaṇasampūrte ssūcanāyeha vṛtkṛtiḥ||341|| bhvādi syādākṛtigaṇaśculumāpādyā stato'pare| saṅgṛhītā bhavantīha ṛtassautro'para ssmṛtaḥ||342|| bahavo'yaṃ jugupsāyāṃ kṛpāyāṃ ceti cāpare|| iti bhvādayaḥ atha ādādayaḥ parasmaipadinau syātāmatha dvau bhakṣaṇe tvadaḥ| hiṃsāgatyo rhano'niṭkāvubhāvetau smṛtāvatha||1|| svariteśca catvāro dviṣo'prītau smṛto duhaḥ| prapūraṇe dohanaṃ hi prapūraṇamūdāhṛtam||2|| tathopacaya ākhyāto diha āsvādane lihaḥ| vyaktāyāṃ vāci cakṣiṅ syāddivaṣādyāḥ pañca cāniṭaḥ||3|| darśane'pi ca cakṣiṅ syādanudāttānubandhakāḥ| pṛcyantāssyuḥ pañcadaśerastu syādgatikampayoḥ||4|| īrisstutāvathaiś‌varya īśo'thāsaḥ punarbudhaiḥ| upaveśana ākhyāta icchāyāṃ śāsurāṅyutaḥ||5|| vasa ācchādane prokto gatiśāsanayoḥ kasiḥ| eke tvanididityāhuśśānto'pyanidiṣyate||6|| ṇisissyāccumbane dantyānto'yaṃ tālavyapaścimaḥ| ityābharaṇakārastu babhrāmaṇi rucyate||7|| śuddhāvavyaktaśabde syācchiji varṇe'pi jaḥ smṛtaḥ| eke samarcana iti hyubhayatreti kecana||8|| anye'vayava ityāhu śśabde'vyakta itītare| pṛjītyekavarjane syādvṛjīrdanyoṣṭhayapūrvakaḥ||9|| prokto'sāvididityanye pṛcī ssamparjanassmṛtaḥ| ṣūjbhavetprāṇināṃ garbhapravimocanakarmaṇi||10|| śīṅ svapne'tha stucaramāḥ parasmaipadino ñitaḥ| yu rmiśraṇe'miśraṇe ca ruśśabde hiṃsane gatau||11|| vṛddhau ca sautra sturaniḍathaṇasstutikarmaṇi| ṭukṣuśśabde parsravaṇe ṣṇurācchadanakarmaṇi||12|| ūrṇuñ dyussyādabhigame prasavaiśvaryayostuṣuḥ| prasavastvabhyanujñānaṃ kuśśabde hyaniṭāvimau||13|| ṣṭuñsyāttsuntau bruñ tu vāci vyaktāyāmaniṭāvimau| ñittvātpadadvayārhau ca parasmaipadinastviṅam||14|| vihāya śāsu paryantā aṣṭāviṃśati saṅkhāyakāḥ| iṇ‌gatāviṅtvadhyayane'dhipūrvo'bhimatassadā||15|| smaraṇe syādigayamapyadhipūrvassadā mataḥ| vīrassyadgativyāptikāntiprajanāsamakhādane||16|| garbhagrahassyātprajano hyasanaṃ kṣepaṇaṃ matam| īkāro'trānyadhātussan praśleṣātsammatasstām||17|| yāḥ prāpaṇe gatistaddhi vā gatau gandhane'pi ca| gandhanaṃ sūcanaṃ dīptau bhāśśauce ṣṇā ihocyate||18|| śrātiratra bhavetpāka ādantānāṃ hi madhyabhāk| drāḥ kutsāyāṃ gatau psā syād bhakṣaṇe pāstu rakṣaṇe||19|| rā syāddāne lā ādāno dāne syātāmabhāviti| prāha candro dāblavane khyāḥ syātprakathane'sya tu||20|| saṃpūrvakasyāprayogaṃ nyāsakāro'numanyate| mā ssyānmāne'karmako'yamupasargavaśena tu||21|| ārthāntare sakarmātaḥ prayogo viduṣāmasau| udaraṃ muṣṭinā ko'pi parimātīti saṅgataḥ||22|| paca dhātustu viduṣāṃ saṃmataḥ paribhāṣaṇe| prayujyate nāntiparo bahusaṃkhyāparo na hi||23|| ityanye jhiparo neti pare prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ| iṇṇādyāvacaparyantā dhātavastvaniṭo matāḥ||24|| vido jñāne'stirākhyāto bhuvi śuddhau mṛjūbhaven| rudiraśruvimoke syā syāññiṣvāpchaya udāhṛtaḥ||25|| śvasassyātprāṇane'naśca jakṣo bhakṣaṇahāsayoḥ| jāgṛnidrākṣaye prokto daridrā durgatau smṛtaḥ||26|| tathā dīptau ca kāsṛ syācchāsu sssayādanuśāsane| dīptidevanayoḥ prokto dīdhīṅṅita upakramāt||27|| chandasā dhātavaḥ pañca proktāvevīṅtu vetinā| tulye'thasyu rdhātavo'tra parasmaipadinastrayaḥ||28|| ṣasassastirbhavetsvapne vaśaḥ kāntau prakīrtitaḥ| kāntiricchā carkarītaṃ cetyatra gaṇasūtrakam||29|| yaṅlugantamadādau hi bodhyamityarthakaṃ smṛtam| ukto'panayane hānuṅtu sammato'niḍayaṃ satām||30|| ityadādayaḥ atha juhotyādayaḥ hardānādanayoḥ prokta ādāne ceti kecana| prāhurbhāṣye prīṇane'pītyuktaṃ dānapadasya tu||1|| prekṣapo'rthasso'pi vai dhā dhāre ca haviṣāmiti| svabhāvāllabhyata itaścatvārassyuranukramāt||2|| parasmaipadino'tha syāññibhīrbhaya udāhṛtaḥ| hrīrlajjāyāṃ pālane ca pūraṇe cāpi pṛrmutaḥ||3|| hrasvānto'yamiti tvanye dhāraṇe poṣaṇe ḍubhṛñ| maṅsyānmāne ca śabde ca gatāve hṅsmṛtastataḥ||4|| ohāktyāge bhavetso'yaṃ parasmaipadabhājanam| ḍudāñdāne ḍudhāñtu syāddhāraṇe poṣaṇe'pi ca||5|| trakayassyussvīriteto'tha ṇijir śauce ca poṣaṇe| vijir bhavetpṛthagbāve viṣlṛ vyāptau prakīrtyate||6|| parasmaipadino'tha ssyuśchāndasā agaṇāntataḥ| ghṛsyātkṣaraṇadīptayo rhṛ prasahyakaraṇe smṛtaḥ||7|| gatāvṛsṛ bhavetāṃ dvāvṛ bhāṣāyāmapi smṛtaḥ| bhaso bhartsanadīptyo ssyātkirjñāne tvaraṇe turaḥ||8|| dhiṣaśśabde'tha dhānye syāddhano'tha janane janaḥ| gāssyātsutau juhotyādyāḥ sasartyantāśca dhātavaḥ||9|| ciketiśca jigātiścāpyaniṭassyurigoditāḥ||10|| iti juhotyādayaḥ atha divādayaḥ parasmaipadino'tha syuḥ jhṛṣantāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ| krīḍāyāṃ vijigīṣāyāṃ vyavahare dyutau stutau||1|| modemadesvapnakāntyorgatau cāpi divussmṛtaḥ| ṣivu ssyāttantusantāne gatiśoṣaṇayossrivuḥ||2|| ṣṭhivurnirasane proktaḥ kecinnehasa paṭhantyamum| ṣṇusu ssyādadane kecidādāna iti cakṣate||3|| apare'darśane iti ṣṇasurnirasane mataḥ| knasurhvaraṇadīptyo ssyātkauṭilyaṃ hvaraṇaṃ matam||4|| vyuṣo dāhe pluṣaścātha gātravikṣepaṇe nṛtīḥ| trasīdvega ākhyātaḥ pūtībhāve kutho mataḥ||5|| pūtībhāvastu daurgandhyaṃ hiṃsāyāṃ putha īritaḥ| parivaṣṭena ākhyāto gudho'tha preraṇe kṣipaḥ||6|| puṣpo vikasena prokta stimatīmau tathā ṣṭimaḥ| ṣṭīścārdrībhāva uktā vrīḍaścodanalajjayoḥ||7|| iṣo gatau ṣaha ṣuhau cakyarthe samudāhṛtau| cakyarthasstṛptiruktā jṛṣ jhṛṣ vayohānikarmaṇi||8|| pūjbhavetprāṇināṃ garbhavimocanakarmaṇi| dūṅ bhavetparitāpe dīhkṣaye'niṭko'yamīritaḥ||9|| vihāyasā gatau ḍīṅghi ṅādhāre mīṅ tu hiṃsane| hiṃsāprāṇaviyogo'tra sravaṇe rīṅ prakīrtitaḥ||10|| pīṅ pāne māṅtu māne syādīṅgatau prīṅ sakarmakaḥ| prītau syādatha catvāraḥ parasmaipadinaḥ smṛtāḥ||11|| śo tanūkaraṇe cho tu chedane ṣo'ntakarmaṇi| do'vakhaṇ‍ḍana ākhyāto dhīṅādyā aniṭa ssmṛtāḥ||12|| atha pañcadaśocyanta ātmanepadinaḥ kramāt| prādurbhāve janīrdīpī rdīptivāpyāyane tviha||13|| pūrīratha bhavettūrī rgati tvaraṇāhiṃsayoḥ| dhūrīrgūrīśca hiṃsāyāṃ gatyāṃ ca parikīrtitau||14|| ghūrīrjūrīś‌ca hiṃsāyāṃ vayohānyā ca kīrtitau| hiṃsāstambhanayo śśūrīścūrīrdāhe prakīrtitaḥ||15|| tapa aiś‌varya iti vā caramaṃ sūtramiṣyate| aiśvarye'yaṃ taṅ śyanau vā bhajatītyarthakaṃ smṛtam||16|| parasmaipadyanyathā śabdaḥ ba ityarthabodhakam| icchanti kecidvā śabdamatrādyāvayavaṃ vṛtoḥ| ato vā vṛtyamānā sā rāmaśālāṃ nyavikṣata||17|| iti bhaṭṭiprayogastu tanmūla iti cakṣate| pāṭhāntaram patetyevaṃ vyatyāsena prakīrtitam| vṛturvaraṇa ākhyāta upatāpe kliśassmṛtaḥ| kāśṛ dīptau vāśṛṃ śabde svariteto'tha pañca ca||18|| titikṣāyāṃ mṛṣaḥ prokta īśucir tu prakīrtyate| pūtībhāve sa tu kledo bandhane ṇaha iṣyate||19|| rañjo rāga athākrośe śapo'niṭ kāṇahādayaḥ| trayo'pyekādaśātha syuranudāttānubandhakāḥ||20|| gatau padaḥ khido dainye sattāyāṃ vida iṣyate| syād‌budho'vagame samprahāre yudha udāhṛtaḥ||21|| anau rudhaḥ kāma uktaḥ padādyā aniṭo'tra ṣaṭ | aṇastu prāṇane dantyānto'yamityeta ūcire||22|| mano jñāne samādhau syādyujaścittanirodhanam| samādhirucyate tasmādakarmaka udāhṛtaḥ||23|| sṛjo visarge'karmāyaṃ liśo'lpībhāva iṣyate| manādayo'niṭo'thasyu rāgaṇāntādyatākramam||24|| parasmaipadino vṛddhāvevarādho hyakarmakāt| ityasya gaṇasūtrasya tvartha evaṃ smṛto budhaiḥ||25|| bhinnakramo'traiva śabdo'karmakādeva rādhyateḥ| śyan syāditi tato vṛddhāvityudāharaṇaṃ hyataḥ||26|| na dūye sātvatī sūnuryanmahyamaparādhyati| ityatra rādhyatītyasya druhyatītyartha iṣyate||27|| kriyāsamabhihāreṇa virādhyantaṃ kṣameta kaḥ| ityatrārthastu druhyantamutyūhyo hi manīṣibhiḥ||28|| rādhyatyodana ityatra sidhyatītyartha iṣyate| kṛṣṇāya rādhyatītyatra daivaṃ cintayatīti ca||29|| ayaṃ svādau curādau ca paṭhyate hi gaṇadvaye| vyadha ssyāttāḍane puṣṭau puṣa ssyācchoṣaṇe śuṣaḥ||30|| tuḥ prītau duṣaḥ prokto vaikṛtye'tha śliṣo bhavet| āliṅge'tra rādhādyā dhātavassapta cā'niṭaḥ||31|| śako vibhāṣita iha marṣaṇe samudāhṛtaḥ| atrobhayapadītyartho vibhāṣitadasya hi||32|| ṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe tattugharma sṛtissmṛtā| nyāsakārādayo'yaṃ hi ñīd bhavediti cakṣate||33|| haradattādayo neti krudhaḥ krodhe prakīrtitaḥ| bubhukṣāyāṃ kṣudhaśśauce śudhassaṃrāddhikarmaṇi||34|| ṣidhu rudittva pāṭho'sya prāmādika udāhṛtaḥ| śakādayo'niṭaṣṣaṭssyu sseṭkamāhuśśakaṃ pare||35|| saṃrāddhau caiva hiṃsāyāṃ radhassaṃrāddhiratra tu| niṣpatti ruktā'tha ṇaśo'darśane prīṇane tṛpaḥ||36|| tarpaṇaṃ tṛptirapyatra prīṇanaṃ parikīrtitam| harṣamohanayoḥ prokto dṛpo garvo'tra mohanam||37|| jighāṃsāyāṃ druhaḥ prokto mūho vaicittya īritaḥ| vaicittyamaviveko'tra ṣṇuha udgiraṇe smṛtaḥ||38|| ṣṇihaḥ prītau radhādīnāṃ samāptidyotako'travṛt| śamustūpaśame proktaḥ kāṅkṣāyāṃ tamudīritaḥ||39|| damu stūpaśame'tropaśamo ṇyantaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| tasmātsakarmako'yaṃ mākarmakaśśamavatsmṛtaḥ||40|| śramu stapasi khede cānavasthāne bhramurmataḥ| kṣamūssahana ukto'tha klamurglānau prakīrtitaḥ|.41|| madīharṣe kṣepaṇe'suḥ prayatne yasurīritaḥ| jasu ssyānmokṣaṇa upakṣaye tasu rudāhṛtaḥ||42|| dasuścātha vasu stambhe baśādyo'yamitītare| vyuṣo vibhāge pāgdāhe paṭhito'pyarthabhedakaḥ||43|| aṅarthaṃ paṭhyate bhūya oṣṭhyādyo dantyapaścimaḥ||44|| vyusetyanye'yakāro'yaṃ busityapara ūcire| pluṣo dāhe preraṇe syādbisa saṃśleṣaṇe kusaḥ||45|| utsarge tu busaḥ proktaḥ khaṇḍane musa īritaḥ| pariṇāme masīḥ proktaḥ pariṇāmastu vikriyā||46|| kcitsamīriti prāhurluṭa ukto viloḍane| samavāya ucaḥ prokto bhṛśurbhraṃśuru bhāvapi||47|| adhaḥpatana ākhyātau vṛśassyādvaraṇe kṛśaḥ| tanūkaraṇa ukto ñītpipāsāyāṃ tṛṣassmṛtaḥṣa||48|| hṛṣastuṣṭau ruṣariṣau hiṃsāyāṃ parikīrtitau| ḍipaḥ kṣepe kupaḥ krodhe vyākulatve gupassmṛtaḥ||49|| yupūrupurlupuś‌caiva vimohana udīritāḥ| lubho gārdhye gardhyamatra hyākāṅkṣā parikīrtitā||50|| kṣubhassañcalane prokto hiṃsāyāṃ ṇabhatubhyatī| ārdrībhāve klidūḥ prokto ñimidā snehena mataḥ||51|| snehena mocane cāpi ñiṣvidāḥ parikīrtitaḥ| ṛdhurvuddhau gṛdhurabhikāṃkṣāyāṃ vṛtkṛtistviha||52|| vuṣādeśca divādeś‌ca samāptidyotanīmatā| vuṣādiparipūrtyarthameva vṛtkṛraṇaṃ smṛtam||53|| tathā kṣīyata ityādi sidhyatītyapare jaguḥ||54|| iti divādayaḥ atha svādayaḥ ṣuñsyādabhiṣave snānaṃ snapanaṃ pīḍanaṃ tathā| ihābhiṣavaśabdoktaṃ surasandhānameva ca||1|| tatra snāne'karmako'yaṃ ṣiñtu bandhana īritaḥ| tālavyādi śśiñ niśāne ḍumiñprakṣepaṇe smṛtaḥ||2|| cayane ciñ kathyate stṛñ prokta ācchādane'tha kṛñ| hiṃsāyāmaniṭassapta sunotyādyāḥ prakīrtatāḥ||3|| varaṇe vṛñ kampane dhuñ dīrghānto dhūñapīṣyate| hrasvānto'yamaniṭkaḥ syātparasmaipadinastataḥ||4|| bhavanti nava tatrādya upatāpe ṭudu ssmṛtaḥ| hissyād‌gatau ca vṛddhau ca pṛ prātau parikīrtitaḥ||5|| prītipālanayo sspṛssyātprītau ca calane'pi ca| ityanye calanaṃ svāmī prāha jīvanamityapi||6|| smrityeke'nye spṛṇokyādīṃstrīnāhuśchāndasā iti| āplṛvyāptau śaklṛ śak‌tau rādhasādhau matāviha||7|| saṃsiddhau ca dunotyādyā navāpīhāniṭo matāḥ| atha dvāvanudāttetāvaśūrvyāptāvatha ṣṭighaḥ| āskandane'thāgaṇāntātparasmaipadino matāḥ||8|| tika stigo gatau ca syāccātsyādāskandane ṣaghaḥ| hiṃsāyāṃ ñi dhṛṣā tu syātprāgalbhye parikīrtitaḥ||9|| dambhurdambhana ākhyāto dambhanaṃ dambha ucyate| ṛdhu rvṛddhau prīm̐ṇane'tra tṛpa ityeka ūcire||10|| chandasītyatrāgadaṇāntādadhikāra ssamīritaḥ| aṅo vyāptau daghastu syād ghātane pālane'pi ca||11|| camussyādbhakṣaṇe'tha syurhiṃsāyāṃ rikṣireva ca| cirirjirirdāśṛdṛca trayorikṣirdṛcāniṭaḥ||12|| kṣirbhāṣāyāmapītyeka eka eva kṣirityapi| ajādirdhāturityanye vṛtsvāderiha pūrtaye||13|| iti svādayaḥ atha tudādayaḥ tudassyād‌vyathane prokta ssvariteto'niṭaśca ṣaṭ| ṇudaḥ preraṇa ākhyāto diśassyādatisarjane||1|| atrātisarjanaṃ dānaṃ bhrasjaḥ pāke prakīrtitaḥ| kṣipaḥ preraṇa ākhyātaḥ kṛṣastu syādvilekhane||2|| parasmai pṛdyaṣīratra gatyarthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| juṣīḥ prītau sevane ca catvāra ita āditaḥ||3|| ātmanepadinaḥ prok‌tā ovijīś‌calane bhaye| utpūrvaḥ prāyaśaścāyamolasjī rolajīrapi||4|| parasmaipadino'tha syu rdaśottaraśataṃtviha| ovraścūśchadane prokto vyaco vyājīkṛtau mataḥ||5|| uchiruñche vivāsārtha uchīḥ prokto'tha ṛcchatiḥ| gatīndriya pralayayormūrtibhāve ca kīrtitaḥ||6|| utkleśe syānmicchati stu pīḍotkleśa iheṣyate| jarjaścarco jharjhatiśca tarjane paribhāṣaṇe||7|| tvacassaṃvaraṇe prok‌taḥ stutāvṛca udāhṛtaḥ| uṣjassyādārjave hyujjha utsarge'tha vimohane||8|| lubho vimohanamīhākulīkaraṇamīritam| nindāhiṃsādānayuddhakatthaneṣu ripho mataḥ||9|| rihetyeke tṛpastṛmpha stuptau hi parikīrtitau| ādya ssyātprathamānto'tra dvitīyānto dvitīyakaḥ||10|| dvitīyāntau dvāvapīti pare'tha tupatumpatī| tuphastamphaśca hiṃsāyāmutkleśe dṛpadṛmphatī||11|| prathamaḥ prathamānto'tra dvitīyānta itītare| ṛpharmphau tu hiṃsāyāṃ granthe'tra gupha gumphatī||12|| ubhombhau pūraṇe syātāṃ śobhārthe śubha śumbhatī| dṛbhīrgranthe'tha hiṃsāyāṃ granthane ca cṛtīssmṛtaḥ||13|| vidho vidhāne'tha juḍo nuḍaścāpi gatau smṛtau| tavargapañcamānto'yamādya ityeka ūcire||14|| mṛḍassyātsukhane tadvatpṛḍaśca prīṇane pṛṇaḥ| vṛṇaścāpyatha hiṃsāyāṃ mṛṇatiḥ parikīrtitaḥ||15|| tuṇaḥ kauṭilye'tha śubhe karmaṇi procyate punaḥ| pratijñāne muṇaśśabde tathopakaraṇe kuṇaḥ|||16|| śuno gatau druṇo hiṃsāgatikauṭilyakarmasu| bhramaṇe ghuṇaghūrṇau tu dīptyaiśvaryārthakaṣṣuraḥ||17|| kuraśśabde chedane syātkurassaṃveṣṭane muraḥ| kṣuro vilekhane prokto ghuro bhīmārtaśabdayoḥ||18|| purassyādagragamane vṛhūrudyamane tvayam| dantyoṣṭyādiḥ pavargīyādissyādityanya ūcire||19|| tṛhūstṛhūśca tṛṃhūśca hiṃsārthā parikīrtitāḥ| icchāyāṃ tviṣa ākhyātasspardhāyāṃ miṣa īritaḥ||20|| kalaśś‌vaityakrīḍanayo stilasnehe cilastuḥ saḥ| vasane syādvilasane calastu parikīrtitaḥ||21|| ilassvapnakṣepaṇayo rvilassañcaraṇe smṛtaḥ| dantyoṣṭ‌yādirayaṃ proktostvoṣṭ‌yādirbhedane bilaḥ||22|| gahane syāṇṇilo bhāvakaraṇe hila ucyate| uñche proktau śilaṣilau milastu śleṣaṇe mataḥ||23|| likhastvakṣavinyāse kuṭaḥ kauṭilya īritaḥ| puṭassaṃśleṣaṇe proktaḥ kucassaṅkocane mataḥ||24|| gujaśaśabde'tha rakṣāyāṃ guḍaḥ kṣepe ḍipassmṛtaḥ| churaśachedana ākhyāta ssaphuṭo vikasena mataḥ||25|| pramardane tathākṣepe muṭassyācchedane truṭaḥ| vāśyanvikaraṇo'yaṃ syāttuṭaḥ kalahakarmaṇi||26|| cuṭacchuṭau chedane'tha juḍo bandhana īritaḥ| kaḍo made'tha luṭati ssaṃśleṣaṇa udīritaḥ||27|| kṛḍo ghanatve'tha bhavedghanatvaṃ sāndratā matā| kuḍo bālye puṭastu syādutsarge ghuṭati stu saoḥ||28|| partighāte toḍane syāttuḍo bhadastu toḍanam| thuḍhasthuḍau saṃvaraṇe khuḍaśchuḍa itītare||29|| sphurasphulau sañcalane sphurastu sphuraṇe smṛtaḥ| sphula ssañcalane prokta ityeke paricakṣate|.30|| akāropadhakaṃ kecitpaṭhanti sphara ityapi| spuḍaścuḍo bruḍaśścaite matāssaṃvaraṇe trayaḥ||31|| nimajjane kruḍabhṛḍāvityeke bruvate budhāḥ| gurīrudyamane prokto hyanudāttedayaṃ mataḥ||32|| stavane ṇūstu dīrghāntaḥ parasmaipadinastvitaḥ| ārabhya syurhi catvāro dhūrvidhūnana iṣyate||33|| guḥ purīṣotsarga ukto dhrurgatisthairyayorimau| aniṭau dhruva ityetpāṭhāntaramapīṣyate||34|| kuṅ śabde 'niḍimaṃ prāhurdīghānta kaiyaṭādayaḥ| hrasvāntaṃ nyāsatārādyāḥ kuṭādeḥ pūrtaye'tra vṛt||35|| pṛṅ vyāyame prāyaśo'yaṃ vyāṅ pūrvaḥ kathyate budhaiḥ| prāṇatyāge mṛṅ sapta syuḥ parasmaipadino hyathā||36|| riḥpirgatau dhāraṇe dhiḥ kṣirnivāse gatāvapi| pṛṅṅādayaḥ ṣaḍaniṭaḥ ṣūstu preraṇa īritaḥ||37|| kṛrvikṣepanigaraṇe gṛrdṛṅādara āṅyutaḥ| avasthāne dhṛṅdaśa ṣaṭ parasmaipadinastvatha||38|| ñīpsāyāṃ praccha udito vṛtkirādeḥ samāptaye| sṛjo visarge kathitaḥ śuddhau masjo nigadyate||39|| rujo bhaṅge nigadito bhujo kauṭilya īritaḥ| chupaḥ sparśe ruśariśau hiṃsāyāṃ liśatirgatau||40|| spṛśaḥ saṃsparśane'niṭkādṛṅṅādyā dvādaśa kramāt| viccho gatāvathaviśaḥ praveśana udāhrataḥ||41|| mṛśa āmarśane prok‌taḥ sparśa āmarśanaṃ matam| ṇudastu preraṇe ṣadlṛ prokto viśaraṇe gatau||42|| tathāvasādane cātha śadlṛ śātana īritaḥ| viśādayoniṭaḥ pañca svariteto'tha ṣaṇamatāḥ||43|| milassyātsaṅgame mṛclṛ mokṣaṇe chedane luplṛ| vidlṛ lābhe lipa upadehe vṛddhiḥ sa iṣyate||44|| ṣicaḥ syātkṣaraṇe'niṭkā mucādyāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ| vindatirvyāghrabhūtyādimate seṭkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ||45|| parasmaipadino'tha syuḥ trayo'thaccheṃdane kṛtīḥ| khido dainye hyaniṭko'yaṃ piśo'vayava īritaḥ||46|| mudādeśca tudādeśca samāptidyotanāya vṛt|| iti tudādayaḥ atha rudhādayaḥ rudhirāvaraṇe prektaḥ svariteta ito nava| iritaśca bhidirtu syādvidāraṇa udāhṛtaḥ||1|| chidirtu dvaidhīkaraṇe ricirtu syādvirecane| vicirpṛthagbhāva uktaḥ kṣudir sampeṣaṇe mataḥ||2|| yujiryoge'niṭaḥ sapta rudhādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ| ucchṛdirdevane dīptāvathānādarahiṃsayoḥ||3|| utṛdissyātkṛtīḥ prokta śchedane veṣṭane'pi ca| parasmaipadyayamatho ñīdindhīrdīptibodhakaḥ||4|| ātmanepadino'thasyusarita ārabhya tu trayaḥ| khido dainye vidaḥ prokto vicāre hyaniṭā vimau||5|| parasmaipadino'tha syurdaśa dvau ca yathākramam| viśeṣaṇe śiṣlṛ proktaḥ piṣlṛ sañcūrṇane smṛtaḥ||6|| bhañjo tvāmardane proktaḥ pālanābhyavahārayoḥ| bhujo'niṭo'mī catvāraḥ śiṣādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ||7|| tṛho hisiśca hiṃsāyāmundī syātkledanārthakaḥ| bhavedadhāñjū rvyaktau ca ślakṣṇe kāntau gatāvapi||8|| tañcū saṅkocane prokta ovjīścalane bhaye| vṛjī ssyādvarjanārtho'tha pṛcī ssamparcanārthakaḥ||9|| radhādigaṇasampūrtidyotanāyātra vṛtkṛtiḥ|| iti rudhādayaḥ atha tanādayaḥ vistāre syāttanussapta svariteta itaḥ kramāt| ṣaṇurdāne'tha hiṃsāyāṃ kṣaṇu ssyātkṣiṇureva ca||1|| ṛṇu rgatau syadadane tṛṇurdīptau ghṛṇuḥ smṛtaḥ| atha dvāvanudāttetau vanuryācana īritaḥ||2|| parasmaipadyasau cāndramate'tho avabodhane| manu ḍukṛñ tu karaṇe'niṅvṛdgaṇasamāptaye||3|| iti tanādayaḥ atha kyrādayaḥ ḍu krīñvinimaye dravyakarmake samudīritaḥ| prīñ tarpaṇe syātkāntau ca śrīñ pākai mīñ tu hiṃsane||1|| ṣiñ bandhane'thāpravame skuñ krīñādyā ihāniṭaḥ| stanbhusskunbhu stathā skanbhu sskuśceti catuṣṭayam||2|| sautraṃ sarvaṃ rodhanārthaṃ parasmaipadiseṅbhavet| prathamaś‌ca tṛtīyaś‌ca stambhārthī parikīrtitau||3|| niṣkāṣaṇe dvitīyasyāccaturtha stvavadhāraṇe| ityāha mādhavo yuñ tu bandhane'niṭ prakīrtitaḥ||4|| knūñ śabde tu hiṃsāyāṃ pavane pūñ prakīrtitaḥ| lūñ chedane kathyate'tha stṛñ ācchādanaīryate||5|| kṛñ hiṃsāyāṃ vṛñ varaṇe dhūñ kampana udāryate| trayoviṃśatirākhyātā badṛnātyantā yathākramam||6|| parasmaipadinaḥ śṛssyāddiṃsāyāmatha pṛrmataḥ| pālane pūraṇe cātha varaṇe vṛrnigadyate||7|| āhurbharaṇa ityeke bhartsane bhṛrudīryate| prāhustaṃ bharaṇe'pyeke mṛrhiṃsāyāṃ prakīrtyate||8|| dṛḥ syādvidāraṇe sṛstu vayohānau nigadyate| jhṛrityeke dhṛriti ca pare nṛ ssyānnaye'tha kṛḥ||9|| hiṃsāyāmṛstu gatyāṃ gṛśśabde jyā vayasaḥ kṣaye| rī ssyādgatau reṣaṇe ca vṛk śabdo'tra reṣaṇam||10|| lī śśleṣaṇe vlīrvaraṇe plīrgatau vṛtkṛti stviha| lvādīnāṃ pūrtyārthamīṣṭā pvādīnāṃ ceti kecana||11|| varaṇe vṛñ bhaye bhṛñ syādbharaṇe'nyetvimaṃ viduḥ| kṣīṣ hiṃsāyāṃ jñā atha syādavabodhanabodhakaḥ||12|| bandhaḥ syābdandhane jyādyā avṛñbhṛño'niṭo matāḥ| vṛṅ sambhaktau bhavecchranthaḥ pratiharṣe vimocane||13|| caturviṃśatirākhyātāḥ parasmaipadinastvitaḥ| mantho viloḍane śranthaḥ sandarbhe grantha eva ca||14|| kunthaḥ saṃśaleṣaṇe proktaḥ saṃkleśana itītare| kutha ityāha durigo'tha mṛdaḥ kṣode mṛḍastviha||15|| kṣode sukhe'pyatha gudho roṣe niṣkarṣa kuṣaḥ| kṣubhaḥ sañcalane syātāṃ hiṃsāyāṃ hi ṇabhastubhaḥ||16|| kliśū rvibādhane prokto bhojane'śaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| uñchodhrasa eke 'trokāraṃ dhātvaṅgamūcire||17|| iṣa stvābhūkṣṇya ākhyātaḥ paunaḥ punyaṃ tadīritam| bhṛśārtho vā'pyatha viṣo viprayoge'niḍiṣyate||18|| pruṣapluṣausnehane vā puraṇeṣu puśastu saḥ| puṣṭau steye muṣobhūtaprādurbhāve khacaḥ smṛtaḥ||19|| bhūtaprādurbhāva ihātikrāntotpattiriṣyate| vānto'yamityeka āhirheṭhascoktārthakaḥ smṛtaḥ||20|| upādāne grahaḥ proktaḥ svaritedayamiṣyate| vṛtkṛtiḥ kyrādidhācūnāṃ samāptidyotanīmatā||21|| iti kyrādayaḥ atha curādayaḥ curasteye citi ssmṛtyāṃ yatrissaṅkocane mataḥ| sphuḍissyātparihāse'tra pāṭhāntaramiti sphuṭiḥ||1|| darśanāṅkanayorlakṣaḥ kudristvanṛtabhāṣaṇe| kuḍītyeke prāhurathopasevāyāṃ laḍaḥ smṛtaḥ||2|| midirbhavetsnehane'thau laḍirutkṣepaṇe mataḥ| idatraukāra ityeka ukārādiritītare||3|| jalopavāraṇe prokto laja ityeka ūcire| pīḍo'vagāhane prokto naṭo'vasyandane mataḥ||4|| nāṭyaṃ tvavasyandanaṃ syātprayatne śratha īritaḥ| eke prasthāna ityāhu rbadassaṃyamane mataḥ||5|| bandheti prāha candraḥ pṛḥ pūraṇetho'rja ucyate| balaprāṇanayoḥ pakṣaḥ parigraha udīritaḥ||6|| varṇaścūrṇaḥ preraṇe'nye varṇo varṇana ityapi| uktaḥ prathastu prakhyāne pṛthaḥ prakṣepa īritaḥ||7|| prāhureke patha iti sambandhe ṣamba īryate| śambaśca sāmba ityeke bhakṣastvadana iṣyate||8|| cedane bhartsane kuṭṛ ekate pūraṇa ityapi| alpībhāve puṭṛ cuṭṭāvaṭṛṣuṭṭāvanādare||9|| luṇṭasstyeye śvaṭha śaṭhāvasaṃskāre gatāvapi| śvaṭhītyeke tujipijī hiṃsādānabaleṣvatha||10|| niketane cātha tujaḥ pija ityapare jaguḥ| eke prāhurlaja lujī iti gatyāṃ pisaḥ smṛtaḥ||11|| ṣāntvassāmaprayoge'tha paribhāṣaṇa īritau| śvalkavalkau snehane syātṣṇiha ssphiṭa itītare||12|| anādare smiṭaḥ syāt ṣmiṅṅanādara itītare| śliṣassyācchleṣaṇe gatyāṃ pathiḥ picchastu kuṭṭane||13|| chadiḥ ssaṃvaraṇe dāne śraṇaḥ prāyo vipūrvakaḥ| āghāte taḍa ukto'tha khaḍaḥ khaḍi kaḍī trayaḥ||14|| bedane rakṣaṇe'tha syātkuḍi ssyādveṣṭane guḍiḥ| imaṃ rakṣaṇa ityeke kuṭhirityapare jaguḥ||15|| guḍirityapi kecittu khuḍiḥ khaṇḍana īritaḥ| vaḍirvibhājane prokto vaḍirityeka ūcire||16|| caṇḍe caḍi kapī harṣe bhūṣāyāṃ ca maḍiḥ smṛtaḥ| kalyāṇe bhaḍirākhyāto vamane charda īritaḥ||17|| ādarānādarārthau hi pustabustau prakīrtitau| cudaḥ saṃcodane prokto ṇakkadhakkau tu nāśane||18|| vyathane cukkacakkau staḥ kṣalaḥ syācchaucakarmaṇi| praciṣṭhāyāṃ talaḥ prokta unmāne tula īritaḥ||19|| utkṣepaṇe dulaḥ prokto mahattve pula ucyate| culaḥ samucchrāya ukto rohaṇe mūla īritaḥ||20|| kalo vikṣepa udito bhedane bila īryate| snehano tila ākhyāto bhṛtaucala udīritaḥ||21|| pālaḥ syādrakṣaṇe lūṣo hiṃsāyāṃ māna iṣyate| śulbaḥ śūrpaścātha cuṭaścedane samudīritaḥ||22|| piṭaḥ sañcūrṇane prokto nāśane paḍirucyate| pasiścātha vajo mārgasaṃskāre ca gatāvapi||23|| śulko'tisparśane proktaścapirgatyāṃ prakīrtataḥ| kṣapiḥ kṣāntyāṃ kṣajiḥ kṛcchrajīvane samudāhṛtaḥ||24|| gatyāṃ śvartaśca śvabhraśca sūtraṃ syājjñapamiccahi|| ayaṃ jñāne jñāpane ca vartate hrasvabāṅiṇaci||25|| pariveṣaṇa ākhyāto yamaśca pariveṣaṇam| iha proktaṃ veṣṭanaṃ na bhojanā nāpi veṣṭanā||26|| parikalkana ākhyātaścahaścapa itītare| syādrahasstyāda ityeke balastu prāṇane mataḥ||27|| ciñ syāttu cayane nānye mito'hetāvidaṃ gaṇe| sūtraṃ ghaṭṭastu calane mustassaṅghāta iṣyate||28|| khaṭṭa ssaṃvaraṇe ṣaṭṭaḥ sphiṭṭaścubirititrayaḥ| hiṃsāyāmatha saṅghāte pūlaḥ pūrṇa itītare||29|| anye puṇa iti prāhuḥ puṃsa syādabhivardhane| bandhane syāṭṭakiḥ kāntikaraṇe dhūsa iṣyate||30|| dantyānto'yaṃ pare mūrdhanyāntaṃ tālavyapaścimam| anye cāhuḥ tathā kīṭo varṇe saṅkocane tviha||31|| cūrṇo'tha pūjaḥ pūjāyāmarkasstavana īritaḥ| eke tapana ityāhurālasye śuṭha iṣyate||32|| śuṭhi śśoṣaṇa ākhyāto jaḍastu preraṇe mataḥ| gajo mārjaśca marcaśca śabdārthāḥ parikīrtitāḥ||33|| ghṛtuḥ prasravaṇe prokta eke srāvaṇa ityapi| vacirvistāravacane tijastu syānniśātane||34|| kṛtassaṃśabdane vardhaśchedane pūraṇe'pi ca| kubirācchādane proktaḥ kubhirityeka ūcire||35|| adarśane libi tubī eka ityāhurardane| vyaktāyāṃ vāci gadito hlapaḥ klapa itītare||36|| hrapa ityapare prāhuścuṭistu cchedane mataḥ| ilaḥ syātpreraṇe mrakṣo mlecchane samudāhṛtaḥ||37|| avyaktavāci lmeccha ssyāt brūso harṣa stathāparaḥ| barhaśca hiṃsārthāḥ kecidgarjo gardaśca nisvane||38|| gardhaḥ syādabhikāṅkṣāyāṃ iti cātra paṭhanti hi| pūrve niketane gurdo jasī rakṣaṇa īritaḥ||39|| kecunmokṣaṇa ityāhuḥ stutāvīḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| hiṃsāyāṃ jasu rākhyātaṛ piḍiḥ saṅghāta ucyate||40|| roṣe ruṣo ruṭa iti kecitkṣepe ḍipo mataḥ| ṣṭūpaḥ samucchrāya ukto'thānudāttānubandhakāḥ||41|| ākusmādatha vijñeyāḥ citassañetane smṛtaḥ| dāmṛ dāne daṃśane tu daśissyāddisirapyatha||42|| daṃśane darśane ca syāddasa ityeka ūcire| ḍapo ḍipaśca saṅghāte proktau tatrirathocyate||43|| kuṭumbadhāraṇe cāndrāḥ kuṭumbamaparaṃ jaguḥ| syādguptabhāṣaṇe matriḥ spaśaḥ syādahaṇe tathā||44|| saṃśleṣaṇe cātha tarjo bhartsaścāpīha tarjane| vasto gandhaścārdane syāt hiṃsāyāṃ viṣka īritaḥ||45|| eke hiṣka iti prāhuḥ niṣkastu parimāṇavāk| baveccalala īpsāyāṃ vitarke syama īryate||46|| gurīrudyamane proktaḥ śamo lakṣa ubhāvapi| ālocane kutsayatiravakṣepaṇa ucyate||47|| truṭa ssyācchaidane kecitkuṭa ityāhuratra tu| galaḥ prasravaṇe prokto bhala ābhaṇḍane smṛtaḥ||48|| kūṭo'pradāne syādeṣo'vasādana itītare| kuṭṭaḥ pratāpane vañcuḥ pralambhana udīritaḥ||49|| śaktibandhana ākhyāto vṛṣastacchaktacibandhanam‌| sāmarthyaṃ syātprajanane śaktisambandha eva ca||50|| madastu tṛtpiyoge'tha divuḥ la syātparikūjane| gṛrvijñāne vidaḥ proktaḥ cetanāyāṃ tathaiva ca||51|| vivāsākhyānayoścāsau caturgaṇyāṃ prapaṭhyate| sattāyāṃ vidyate vetti vinte vicāraṇe||52|| vindate vindati prāptau śyanlukśanaśeṣvidaṃ kramāt| manastambhe jugupsayāṃ yurayaṃ parikīrtitaḥ||53|| kusma nāmno veti gaṇasūtraṃ hyatra prakīrtitam| kusmetyayaṃ dhāturatra kutsita smayanārthakaḥ||54|| carco bhavedadhyayane bukkaḥ syādbhaṣaṇe tathā| āviṣkāre copasargācchabdassyādbhāṣaṇe mataḥ||55|| syāttathānupasargācca kaṇaḥ prokto nimīlane| jabhissyānnāśane ṣūdaḥ kṣaraṇe tāḍane jasuḥ||56|| paśo bandhana ākhyātaḥ stvamo roge prakīrtitaḥ| caṭasphuṭau bhedane staḥsaṅghāte ghaṭa īritaḥ||57|| hantyarthā ścetyatra gaṇasūtraṃ syānmardane divuḥ| arjaḥ syātpratiyatne'tha ghuṣir prokto viśabdane||58|| mokṣo'vasāne samprokto'vasānaṃ kṣepa ucyate| āṅaḥ krando hi sātatye'nye ghuṣaṃ prāhurāṅyayutam||59|| lasaḥ syācchilpayoge'thālaṅkāre syāttasi stathā| būṣaścātha bhavedghoṣo'sane tatkṣepaṇaṃ matam||60|| pūjāyāmarha udito jñāniyoge prakīrtitaḥ| bhajo viśrāṇane proktaḥ śṛdhuḥ prahasane mataḥ||61|| nikāropaskārayoḥ syāt yato'tāsvādane rakaḥ| lagaśca ragha ityeke raga ityapare viduḥ||62|| añcurviśeṣaṇe proktaḥ syāt citrīkaraṇe ligiḥ| mudaḥ saṃsarga ākhyāta straso dhāraṇa iṣyate||63|| prāhurgrahaṇa ityeke syādvāraṇa itītare| uñche syādudhra sya ihokāro dhātvaṅgamiṣyate|||64|| ityāhuḥ kecinnetyanye muco'tha syātpramocane| modane ca vasa stu syāt snehe'paharaṇe tathā||65|| chede cātha caraḥ proktaḥ saṃśaye cyastu kathyate| sahane hasane caike cyusa ityapare viduḥ||66|| bhuvo'vakalkane kecittabhiśrīkaraṇaṃ viduḥ| prāhuścintanāmityanye kṛpe ścātraivaṇijbhavet||67|| sakarmakāditi padaṃ paraskṛtyāspadaḥ padam| gaṇasūtraṃ spadimabhivyāpya ṇictu bhavediha||68|| sambhalatkarmakādevetyarthakaṃ paricakṣate| grasassyādahaṇe syāṇṇicphalaṃ grāsayatīti hi||69|| suvyakta eva vijñeyaḥ karmaṇītyarthakaṃ viduḥ| puṣo dhāraṇa ākhyāto dalaḥ prokto vidāraṇe||70|| paṭaḥ puṭo luṭakuṭau tuji rmija pijī lujiḥ| bhajirlaghistrasi pisī kusi rdaśi kuśi ghaṭaḥ||71|| ghaṭi rbṛhi rbarha balhau gupo dhīpāyati stathā| vicchacīvau yodhayatirlokṛ locṛ ṇadaḥ kupaḥ||72|| lupastarko vṛtu vṛdhū bhāṣārthāḥ parikīrtitāḥ| ruṭo raji rlaji raji rdasi rbhṛśi ruśi rusiḥ||73|| śīko naṭaḥ puṭapuṭī rucirlaghi raghī aghiḥ| rahi rmahi ścātha laḍi staḍirnalayatiśca saḥ||74|| amī api syurbhāṣārthāḥ pūrvadaṇḍakagā iva| athāpyāyana ākhyātaḥ pūrīrhiṃsārthako rujaḥ||75|| ṣvada āsvādane proktaḥ svāda ityeka ūcire| ādhṛṣādvā sūtramito dhṛṣāntā dhātavo'khilāḥ||76|| ṇicaṃ vāmī prāpnuvantītyarthakaṃ gaṇamadhyagam| dhātvimau yujapṛcau matau saṃyamanārthakau||77|| arcaḥ pūjārthakaḥ proktaḥ ṣaho marṣame īritaḥ| īraḥ kṣepe bhavellīsu ssyāddravīkaraṇārthakaḥ||78|| vṛjī ssyādvarjane vṛñ tu prekta āvaraṇārthakaḥ| vayohānyarthako jṛḥ syājjiśca recayatistu saḥ||79|| viyojane tathā samparcane ca parikartitaḥ| śiṣo'sarvopayoge syādvipūrvo'tiśaye mataḥ||80|| tapo dāhe tṛpastṛptau sandīpana itītare| chṛdīḥ sandapane proktaḥ cṛpa śchṛpa dṛpāvapi||81|| syuḥ sandīpana ityeke dṛbhīrbhaye udāhṛtaḥ| dṛbha ssandarbha ākhyāto mokṣaṇe śratha īritaḥ||82|| hiṃsārthamanye bruvate mīrgatau parikīrtitaḥ| grantho bandhana ākhyātaḥ śīka āmarṣaṇe mataḥ||83||? cīkaścāthārda udito hiṃsāyāṃ svaritedayam| hisirhiṃsārthako'rhaḥ syāt pūjāyāmāṅyutaṣṣadaḥ||84|| padyarthe syācchundhayati śaucakarmaṇi kīrtitaḥ| chado'pavāraṇe prokto juṣa ssyātparikarṇane||85|| parikarṇanamūho vā hiṃsā vā parikīrtitau| paritarpaṇa ityanye paritṛptikriyā hi tat||86|| dhūñ kampane bhavetprīñ tu tarpaṇe parikīrtitaḥ| śrandho granthaśca sandarbha āplṛ lambhana īritaḥ||87|| eke'yaṃ sāntvana iti svaritediti kecana| śraddhopakaraṇārthaṃ syāttanu rdairghyai bhavedayam||88|| upasargātparaścātha śraddhāyāṃ kīrtyate canaḥ| tathopahasane ceti kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ||89|| vadaḥ sandeśavacane svaritedayamiṣyate| eke'nudāttedityāhurvacassyātparibhāṣaṇe||90|| pūjāyāṃ māna ākhyāto bhūḥ prāptāvātmanepadī| garho vinindane prokto mārga stvanveṣaṇārthakaḥ||91|| śoke syātkaṭhirūtpūrva utkaṇṭhāyāmatho mṛjūḥ| śauce'laṅkāre'thamṛṣastitikṣāyāṃ prakīrtitaḥ||92|| svaritetsyādayamatha dhṛṣaḥ prasahane smṛtaḥ| āthādantāḥ prakathyante kathādyāśca yathākramam||93|| katho vākyaprabandhe syādīpsāyāṃta vara īritaḥ| gaṇassaṅkhayāna uktastajjñānaṃ saṅkhayāṃ nimitttakam||94|| asudyugbhāṣaṇe syātāṃ śaṭha śvaṭhayatī ubhau| paṭo vaṭaśca granthe syaṭṭhāntāvityeka ūcire||95|| rahastyāge staganadau devaśabde prakīrtitau| pato gatau vā ṇijanto vādanta iti kecana||96|| paṣastvanupasargātsyītsvara ākṣepa īritaḥ| pratiyatne racaḥ proktaḥ saṅkhyāne ca gatau kalaḥ||97|| parikalkanavācī syāccahastatparikalkanam| damabha śśyāṭhyaṃ ceha mataṃ pūjāyāṃ maha īritaḥ||98|| sāraḥ kṛpaśśratha ścaite daurbalye parikīrtitāḥ| īp‌sāyāṃ syātspṛho bhāmaḥ krodhe sūcayati stu saḥ||99|| paiśunye bhakṣaṇe kheṭaḥ tṛtīyāntaṃ pare viduḥ| anye khoṭa iti prāhu kṣoṭaḥ kṣepe prakīrtitaḥ||100|| upalepe goma uktaḥ krīḍāyāṃ parikīrtyate| kumāro'thocyate śīla upadhāraṇābodhakaḥ||101|| upadhāraṇabhyāsaḥ sāmassāntvaprayojane| velaḥ kālopadeśe syātkālaṃ dhātvantaraṃ viduḥ||102|| lavane pavane caiva palpūlaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| sukhasevanayorvātaḥ sevāgatyoritītare||103|| gaveṣaḥ syānmārgam̐ṇe'thopasevāyāṃ prakīrtyate| vāso'thācchādane prokto nivāso'tha pṛthakkṛtau||104|| bhājo'tha darśane prītau sabhājaḥ parikathyate| prītau sevana iṣyate parihāṇe nigadyate||105|| ūno'tha syād‌dhvanaśśabde kūṭastu paritāpavāk| paridāhe'yamityeke saṅketo grāma eva ca||106|| kuṇo guṇaśca samproktā amī āmantraṇārthakāḥ| cātkūṭo'pi samānārthaḥ pāṭhāntaramapīṣyate||107|| keto niketaśca bhavecchrāvaṇe ca nimantraṇe| kuṇo guṇaśceha tathā''mantraṇe samudīritau||108|| cātketakūṭau kūṇaḥ syāt grahaṇe'nveṣaṇe mṛgaḥ| stena ścaurye hyathāgarvādātmanepadino matāḥ||109|| pado gatau gṛhastu syāt grahaṇe'nveṣaṇe mṛgaḥ| kuho vismāpane śūravīrau vikrantibodhakau||110|| bhavet sthūlayati stvatra paribṛṃhaṇavācakaḥ| arthaḥ syādupayāñcāyāṃ satrassantāmakarmaṇi||111|| garvo māne bhavetsūtro veṣṭane parikīrtitaḥ| mūtraḥ prasravaṇe proktaḥ rūkṣaḥ pāruṣya īritaḥ||112|| pārastīra ubhau karmasamāpteḥ pratibodhakau| utsarge syātpuṭo dheko darśanārtha itītare||113|| śaithilye syātkatrayatiḥ karta ityeka ūcire| syātpartipaditād‌dhāto rarthe bahulamiṣṭavat||114|| tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe tenātikrāmatīti ca| dhāturūpaṃ cātha kartṛkaraṇapratibodhakāt||115|| dhātvarthe ṇijitīmāni gaṇasūtrāṇi pañca hi| baṣko darśana ākhyāta ścitraścitrīkṛtau mataḥ||116|| kadāciddarśane tattu bhavedadbhutadarśanam| athāṃsanāmako dhātuḥ samāghāte prakīrtitaḥ||117|| vaṭo vibhājane prokto lajastu syātprakāśane| vaṭirlajiriti hyeke miśrassamparkabodhakaḥ||118|| saṅgrāmo yuddha ākhyāto hyanudāttānubandhakaḥ| ślāghāyāṃ stoma uditaḥ chidrakarṇau tu bhedane||119|| karṇacchedana ityeke karṇaṃ dhātvantaraṃ pare| ando dṛṣṭyāpaghāte syādupasaṃhāra vācyayam||120|| ityante cakṣate daṇḍaḥ prokto daṇḍa nipātane| aṅkaḥ pade lakṣaṇe cāpyaṅgaśca parikathyate||121|| sukhaduḥkhau tatkriyāyāṃ rasa āsvādane tathā| snehane ca vyayo vittasamutsarge prakīrtitaḥ||122|| rūpo rūpakriyāyāṃ syādrūpasyeha hi darśanam| rūpakriyeti samproktaṃ rūpasya kṛtireva vā||123|| chedo dvaidhīkṛtau proktaḥ chada ukto'pavāraṇe| ityeke kathayantīha lābhassyātpreraṇārthakaḥ||124|| vraṇastviha bhavedgātravicūrṇanavibodhakaḥ| varṇo varṇakriyāyāṃ syādvistāre ca guṇoktaciṣu||125|| etannidarśanamiha bahulaṃ gaṇasūtrakam| anye'pi dhātavo bodhyā iha bāhulakādyathā||126|| parṇo haritabhāve syādviṣko darśane iṣyate| kṣapastu preraṇe bodhyo nivāse vasa ityapi||127|| tuttha āvaraṇe bodhyā evamanye'pi dhātavaḥ| ṇiḍaṅgātsyānnirasana
